Best regards,

Kevan

title: AI Video Editor PetSupplement Brand
description:
Can you create an ad that makes someone stop scrolling in the first 2 seconds — and gives them a reason to buy?



If your answer is yes, keep reading.



We’re not looking for another video editor.



We’re looking for someone who can take an idea, turn it into a complete ad using AI, and create content that actually drives sales.



Because a polished video means nothing if nobody watches it.



Great ads start with great hooks, strong messaging, and a clear understanding of what makes people stop, pay attention, and take action.



If you understand that, you might be exactly who we’re looking for.



## What You’ll Do



You’ll create high-converting ads from start to finish using AI.



Your work will include:



* Creating AI avatars

* Producing AI voiceovers

* Creating UGC-style content from scratch

* Editing raw footage when needed

* Developing new hooks, angles, and creative concepts

* Turning ideas into ads designed to generate sales



You won’t just be editing footage.



You’ll be responsible for turning an idea into creative that gets attention and drives action.



## You’re a Great Fit If...



* You don’t just edit — you create

* You’ve already built ads using AI tools

* You understand what makes people stop scrolling

* You know how to create strong hooks and compelling messaging

* You think about conversions, not just aesthetics

* You think like a marketer, not just an editor

* You bring ideas instead of waiting to be told what to do



## AI Experience Is Required



You should already be comfortable using tools like:



* ElevenLabs

* Kie ai

* Higgsfield

* Veo

* Nano Banana



If these tools are completely new to you, this probably isn’t the right role.



We’re looking for someone who can jump in and start creating.



## Bonus Points If...



* You’ve scaled winning ads using AI

* You understand what’s working on Meta

* You know how to spot creative trends early

* You understand direct-response advertising

* You’re constantly coming up with new creative ideas

* You know how to turn one winning concept into multiple variations



## What You’ll Get



* Consistent work

* Performance-based upside

* Access to real campaign data

* Fast, honest feedback

* The opportunity to see which creatives actually drive results

* A team that values creativity, initiative, and performance



## This Isn’t a Typical Video Editing Role



If you’re looking for someone to hand you footage, give you a script, and tell you exactly what to do, this isn’t the role for you.



But if you can look at an ad and immediately think:



“Here’s how I’d make this hook stronger.”



“Here’s why people are dropping off.”



“Here’s a better angle we should test.”



Then we want to hear from you.



If you know how to combine AI, creativity, and marketing to create ads that capture attention and convert, apply below.





HOW TO APPLY:

title: Wedding Film Editor (Luxury Weddings, Long Term)
description:
We're a luxury wedding film studio based in New Jersey. For over 12 years we've filmed 350+ weddings. Our mission is simple: help couples see, hear, and feel their day all over again.



We're growing and looking for an editor who wants to stay and grow with us, not just pick up gigs.



OUR STYLE

Luxurious, cinematic, and built on emotion. Every film should feel custom and intentional, while following a consistent structure:

• A strong opening montage (couple, details, venue) in the first 15 to 30 seconds

• The day told in order: prep, ceremony, reception, with detail shots woven in

• Audio storytelling that carries the film: vows, letters, and a bite from every toast

• Natural emotion between the couple over posed kisses, matched to the mood of the music

• 2 to 3 cinematic, uplifting songs (never poppy or generic) plus natural sound design layers

• Slow motion used sparingly, gentle push-ins on static shots, straight horizons, no repeated shots

• Emotional moments given room to breathe



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Edit highlight films - 4-8 min films - varying

• Pull the strongest audio and build a story around it

• Color using our house LUT, then refine shot by shot

• Mix and clean up audio (vows, toasts, ambient sound)

• Deliver each film within about 1 week, every time

• Communicate early if something needs attention



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Consistent ~1 week turnaround. This is the #1 thing we need, so please only apply if you can deliver on it reliably

• 2+ years editing wedding films, with a portfolio to show it

• Strong in Adobe Premiere Pro

• A storyteller's ear for audio and a musician's sense of pacing

• Comfortable with proxy workflows and large multicam projects

• Reliable internet and a computer that can handle 4K footage

• Clear, honest communication in English, and you take feedback well



WHY WORK WITH US

• Long term, stable role with a team that values you

• Steady work through the year, with busier seasons

• Room to grow into a lead editor role

• Faith and family come first here, and we run the business that way



HOW TO APPLY

1. Send your portfolio (wedding work ONLY)

2. In 2 or 3 sentences, tell us how you would open a wedding film and why

3. Tell us your typical turnaround time for a 4 to 8 minute highlight film

4. Start your application with the words "Timeless Films" so we know you read this



Shortlisted applicants will receive our full style guide, reference films, and a paid test edit of a full wedding highlight film ($100).



If the test edit is a fit, there is consistent, ongoing work available. We're looking for someone to grow with long term.

title: Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) Manager
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) Manager with at least 15 years of relevant professional experience in mergers and acquisitions, transaction advisory, corporate finance, investment banking, or related fields.



The successful candidate will lead and manage M&A transactions from deal origination and evaluation through due diligence, valuation, transaction structuring, negotiation, execution, and post-deal integration. This role will also oversee and develop a team of M&A and transaction advisory professionals, ensuring high-quality deliverables, effective project execution, and sound strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise, strong commercial judgment, proven leadership capabilities, and the ability to manage complex transactions and multidisciplinary teams.



Key Responsibilities

Mergers & Acquisitions and Transaction Execution

• Lead and manage end-to-end M&A transactions, including acquisitions, divestitures, mergers, joint ventures, and strategic investments.

• Identify and evaluate potential acquisition targets and investment opportunities based on strategic fit, financial performance, growth potential, and risk exposure.

• Oversee transaction processes from initial assessment and valuation through due diligence, negotiations, closing, and post-transaction integration.

• Develop transaction strategies, deal structures, and recommendations aligned with organizational objectives.

• Lead negotiations and manage relationships with counterparties, investors, financial institutions, legal counsel, and other external advisers.



Transaction Advisory and Due Diligence

• Lead transaction advisory engagements, including financial due diligence, quality of earnings analysis, working capital assessments, debt-like item analysis, and financial risk identification.

• Assess the financial, operational, commercial, and strategic implications of potential transactions.

• Review financial statements, management accounts, forecasts, business plans, and other transaction-related documentation.

• Identify deal risks, value drivers, synergies, and opportunities to enhance transaction value.

• Review and present due diligence findings, transaction reports, and recommendations to support investment decisions.



Financial Modeling and Valuation

• Oversee the development and review of financial models, valuation analyses, and scenario-based assessments.

• Apply appropriate valuation methodologies, including discounted cash flow (DCF), comparable company analysis, and precedent transaction analysis.

• Conduct sensitivity analyses to evaluate deal assumptions, investment returns, and potential financial outcomes.

• Assess transaction economics, including purchase price, financing structures, expected returns, and post-deal financial impact.



Team Leadership and Development

• Lead, manage, and develop a team of M&A and transaction advisory professionals, providing direction, coaching, and performance feedback.

• Assign and prioritize engagements, allocate resources, and monitor team capacity to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality work.

• Review and quality-check financial models, valuation analyses, due diligence reports, and other transaction deliverables.

• Establish consistent methodologies, work standards, and quality-control procedures across transaction engagements.

• Mentor team members in financial analysis, valuation, transaction execution, client management, and professional development.

• Foster a collaborative, accountable, and performance-driven team culture while promoting continuous improvement.

• Coordinate with cross-functional teams and external advisers to resolve issues, manage deadlines, and achieve transaction objectives.



Strategic and Financial Advisory

• Partner with senior leadership to identify growth opportunities, acquisition targets, divestment opportunities, and strategic partnerships.

• Provide data-driven insights and recommendations on capital allocation, investment decisions, and portfolio optimization.

• Evaluate potential synergies, integration requirements, and opportunities to improve profitability and operational performance.

• Monitor industry trends, market developments, competitor activity, and valuation benchmarks to inform transaction strategy.



Stakeholder and Project Management

• Lead cross-functional teams involving Finance, Legal, Tax, Operations, and other relevant business functions throughout the transaction lifecycle.

• Coordinate external advisers and ensure the timely completion of due diligence, documentation, approvals, and transaction milestones.

• Prepare and present investment memoranda, board presentations, executive summaries, and transaction recommendations to senior management and decision-makers.

• Ensure transactions comply with applicable legal, regulatory, tax, accounting, and corporate governance requirements.

• Support post-merger integration planning and monitor the realization of anticipated synergies and transaction benefits.



Qualifications and Requirements

   - At least 15 years of relevant professional experience in M&A, transaction advisory, investment banking, corporate finance, private equity, financial advisory, or related fields.

   - Demonstrated experience leading complex M&A transactions, including due diligence, valuation, deal structuring, negotiation, and execution.

   - Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing a team of finance, M&A, or transaction advisory professionals.

   - Strong knowledge of transaction advisory practices, including financial due diligence, quality of earnings, working capital analysis, and transaction risk assessment.

   - Advanced financial modeling, valuation, analytical, and commercial assessment skills.

   - Proven ability to evaluate investment opportunities and translate complex financial information into actionable business recommendations.

   - Experience managing multiple transactions or engagements simultaneously, including resource allocation, deadlines, and deliverable quality.

   - Demonstrated ability to engage with senior executives, board-level stakeholders, investors, counterparties, and external professional advisers.

   - Strong leadership, project management, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.

   - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

   - MBA, CPA, CFA, or other relevant professional qualifications are preferred.

Preferred Experience

   - Experience in a Big Four transaction advisory practice, investment bank, corporate development function, private equity firm, or financial advisory firm.

   - Exposure to cross-border transactions, complex deal structures, and multi-stakeholder negotiations.

   - Experience in post-merger integration, synergy assessment, and transaction value realization.

   - Familiarity with relevant financial reporting standards, tax considerations, corporate governance, and regulatory requirements.



Key Competencies

• M&A leadership and transaction execution

• Transaction advisory and financial due diligence

• Business valuation and financial modeling

• Team leadership, coaching, and performance management

• Strategic thinking and commercial judgment

• Risk assessment and analytical problem-solving

• Negotiation and stakeholder management

• Project and resource management

• Executive communication and presentation

• Accountability, decision-making, and professional integrity

title: Sales Follow-Up & Upsell Specialist - Australian Events Company
description:
SALES FOLLOW-UP & UPSELL SPECIALIST

Part-time | 20 hours per week, growing to 30 | Philippines-based independent contractor

Real Deal Entertainment (Australia)



READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY



We are looking for a genuinely strong salesperson. We would rather be blunt about the bar than waste your time or ours.



- Impeccable spoken English. Our clients are Australian corporates, councils, venue managers and school directors. If a client would have to ask you to repeat yourself, this is not the role for you.

- You learn fast. Our customer service lead was working the full product range - three brands, different offerings in every city - inside a week. That is the benchmark, not an aspiration.

- You are fully available for the four hours, every day. Not partially available, not fitting us around another shift that overlaps, not stepping away to take other calls.

- You think on your feet. A memorised answer to a price objection will not get you past the interview - we will push back and see what you do.

- You are motivated by closing, not by being busy. We measure conversations and bookings, not call counts. A high dial count with nothing behind it is a problem, not an achievement.



We have filled this role before with someone diligent and well-intentioned, and it did not work, because the bar above is the bar. We are not lowering it.



THE SHORT VERSION



We send a lot of quotes. Not enough of them turn into bookings. Your whole job is to ring the people who already have one, have a real conversation, and turn it into a sale - adding something to it where the client has room.



Four hours a day, 2:00pm to 6:00pm Melbourne time, Monday to Friday. We picked those hours by measuring when our clients actually answer the phone, not by guessing. You will not be dialling into dead air all morning.



ABOUT US



Real Deal Entertainment runs three brands in Australia: The Real Santa, Halloween Scenes and Happy Easter Bunny. We supply professional performers - Santa, Mrs Claus, elves, the Easter Bunny - and large event props, thrones, grottos and sets, to corporate clients, shopping centres, councils, hospitality venues, schools and childcare centres.



It is a premium product at a premium price, and it is seasonal. September to December is the peak. What we sell varies by city, which means there is a real body of product knowledge to learn, and you will need to learn it quickly.



THE HOURS



Monday to Friday, 2:00pm - 6:00pm Melbourne time (11:00am - 3:00pm Philippine time).

From April, when Australia moves off daylight saving, that becomes 12:00pm - 4:00pm Philippine time.



Your working day follows Australian eastern time all year, so it is the clock in the Philippines that shifts at each changeover, not your hours. Twenty hours a week, year round - not seasonal - growing to thirty (six hours a day) for a strong performer.



PAY



Base: AU$10.00 per hour, paid fortnightly for hours worked. Never clawed back.



Commission, on top of base:

- Upsells and add-ons: 4% of the added portion only - the upgrade you created, not the whole booking

- Cross-brand conversions: 4% - a Christmas enquiry you also turn into a Halloween or Easter booking

- Client win-backs: 5% - first reactivated booking from a dormant account on a list we supply

- Self-generated cold business: 7% - bookings from leads you sourced yourself



Two things we want to be straight about rather than have you discover in month two:

- Closing a quote that was already in the pipeline earns no commission. That work is what the base rate is for. Commission is for what you add.

- Commission is paid on the added portion, after the event has run and the client has paid. It is reversed if the booking is cancelled or refunded. The base is not.



Discounts beyond 5% need approval, and commission is calculated on the discounted value.



Season bonus, on top of base and commission:

- AU$600 when the season revenue target is hit

- AU$900 when the stretch target is hit



This is the part that pays you for the quotes you close that were already in the pipeline. Commission rewards what you add; the season bonus rewards the whole book converting. It is measured on total invoiced revenue for the season, not only on deals with your name on them, because your job is to make the pipeline convert - not to cherry-pick the ones that earn you a percentage.



Our year runs in four seasons - Christmas, Easter, Winter Christmas and Halloween - and each carries its own revenue target, set at the start of it. You will be given the exact figures at offer stage.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



- Work the open quote bank to a definite outcome - booked, lost, or closed with a reason. Nothing sits in limbo.

- Have a proper conversation on every live quote, not a thirty-second check-in. Find out what the client is actually trying to do with their event.

- Offer the upgrade where it genuinely fits - a bigger props package, extra performers, another brand's season. Never pressure.

- Request re-quotes from our customer service team, then confirm they went out and tell the client when to expect them.

- Write a dated note in our CRM on every conversation: what the client wants, what you offered, next action and date.



What you will NOT do:

- Raise quotes or invoices. Our customer service team does that. You request and verify.

- Handle inbound calls.

- Manage anyone. This is not a supervisory role and we are not quietly hoping it becomes one.



WHERE THIS CAN GO



This starts as a focused afternoon block because that is where the quote bank is. It is not where it has to stop.



- Win-backs and cold leads are open to you from the start, at 5% and 7%, and any booking you source that way is yours on the record.

- Four hours becomes six once the afternoon work is being handled well. See above - the mechanism is real and the work is already there.

- We are not looking for someone who only wants to read a list and dial it. If you see something the business should be doing differently, we want to hear it.



HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



Stated up front so there are no surprises. If any of this sounds uncomfortable, this is not the right role for you.



- Conversations, not calls: two minutes or more with a dated CRM note. Five are spot-checked each fortnight against the system.

- An upsell attempt on every conversation: your note names what you offered beyond what was quoted. "Not appropriate here" is a fine answer if you say why.

- Quotes issued and confirmed sent: confirming it reached the client is part of the measure, not an extra.

- Bookings closed: the outcome number.

- Two attempts on a quote follow-up: then a voi
 or
 and the record is closed. Chasing past that wastes your hours and irritates the client.

- Feedback answered within one working day: in writing. Agree, disagree, or ask a question - but reply.

- One thing brought to us each fortnight: something you noticed, suggested or took on that nobody asked you for.



WHO THIS SUITS



- An experienced closer who has sold to Australian businesses and is completely at ease on the phone with corporates, councils and venue managers.

- Someone who will treat four hours as four hours of selling, and who wants those hours to grow into a morning shift.

- Someone who asks the question the moment they are stuck, in writing, rather than going quiet and working it out slowly.

- Someone who can hold a large amount of product detail - what is available in which city, under which brand - and recall it live, mid-call, without looking it up.

- Someone who reads a knock-back as information and adjusts, rather than repeating the same approach louder.



REQUIREMENTS



- A quiet, professional space for client calls, a good noise-cancelling headset, and reliable internet and power with a backup plan.

- Impeccable, confident spoken English with a neutral, easily understood accent. This is not negotiable and it is assessed on the voice recording before anything else.

- You invoice us as an independent contractor and handle your own tax and statutory contributions.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without all three parts will not be read. They take about twenty minutes.



1. A voice recording of 90 seconds. A client has a quote for $1,200 and says "that's more than we budgeted". Talk us through how you would respond. Record it as if you were on the call.

2. In writing, no more than 300 words: a sale you nearly lost and then won. What changed it?

3. In one line: what you would want to know from us before your first call.



Shortlisted applicants do a short live exercise: we give you a product list to read for thirty minutes, then ask you ten questions about it with the document closed, followed by a mock follow-up call.

title: Tax Preparer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Tax Preparer with a strong focus on business tax returns to join our team. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented tax professional who enjoys working closely with business entities to navigate complex filings, minimize liability, and ensure full compliance with federal and state tax regulations.



What You'll Do

- Analyze financial statements, general ledgers, and supporting documentation to ensure accurate reporting

/month

title: Virtual Assistant, Operations & Scheduling
description:
About Bestie



Bestie is a concierge-style pet care company serving Downtown Manhattan. We provide dog walks, drop-ins, daycare, boarding, and house sitting for dogs and cats. Members pay a monthly membership fee and get access to a dedicated concierge team, so they never have to scramble to find someone they trust with their pet. Behind the scenes, a lot of coordination happens. We have 170+ members, 150+ independent contractors who make up our sitter team, and a calendar that changes every day.



The Role



Bestie is growing, and we're adding a second virtual assistant to our operations team. We already have an Executive Assistant who runs our day-to-day operations. You'll work closely with them, take on the behind-the-scenes admin work, and act as their backup so nothing slips through the cracks when things get busy.



At first, your focus will be backend operations: scheduling, booking entry, records, billing checks, responding to
 inquiries, tracking leads, and supporting the Executive Assistant we already have. You won't be handling our concierge phone line at the start. This role suits someone who enjoys owning systems, catches small discrepancies before they become problems, and works well as part of a team.



As you grow into the role, there's also an opportunity to work directly with our members and sitter team and help run our day-to-day concierge line. This isn't the focus at the start, but if you enjoy customer service and relationship management, there's room to grow in that direction as part of a full time role.



Part-Time to Full-Time

The role starts at 20–25 hours per week, with the goal of transitioning to full-time after approximately two months for the right candidate, based on performance and business needs.



Training

You'll get a structured onboarding period during November and December. The training includes:

- Studying our operations handbook

- Shadowing sessions with our current EA

- Handling tasks on your own, then reviewing them together until you're confident



What You'll Do



Scheduling

- Enter each week's confirmed bookings into Time To Pet (a comprehensive, all-in-one pet care management software) and flag any double bookings to the team

- Help schedule recurring and upcoming bookings and keep our sitter availability tracker current




 & lead management

- Respond to new member inquiries by
 and through our website

- Track every lead in our Lead Tracker so no inquiry goes unanswered



Billing, payroll & records

- Help make sure members are charged correctly through Time To Pet

- Double-check invoices before weekly billing runs

- Log bookings in our master Excel tracker



Onboarding

- Members: Set up new member profiles in Time To Pet, create care instruction docs, and update member records

- Sitters: Support the full sitter onboarding process, including profile setup, documentation, availability, and payroll information



What Success Looks Like

- Bookings are entered accurately and on time

- Time To Pet, Google Calendar, and our internal trackers stay in sync

- Double bookings and scheduling conflicts are caught before they become problems

- Member and sitter records are complete and up to date

- Billing discrepancies are identified before invoices are sent

- Every inquiry and lead is tracked and receives a timely response

- You communicate proactively when something is unclear or at risk of being missed



What This Role Is Not

- This is not a personal assistant role.

- You will not be managing the founder's personal schedule or errands.

- You will not be responsible for sales or social media.

- You will not initially be responsible for answering the concierge phone line.



Tools You'll Use

- Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Gmail), Excel, Time To Pet, WhatsApp, Quo

- Experience with Time To Pet or similar booking software is a plus, but we'll train you on our systems.



Who You Are

- At least 3 years of experience as a virtual assistant, executive assistant, or in an admin or operations role, ideally supporting a US-based or services business

- Highly organized and detail-oriented. You notice when a calendar entry, invoice, and spreadsheet don't match, and you fix it.

- Strong written English. You communicate clearly and warmly with members and teammates.

- A good collaborator who keeps your teammate in the loop and is comfortable sharing ownership of systems

- Able to work independently. You won't always have someone available to answer a question immediately. You should be comfortable assessing a situation, checking our existing processes/documentation, and escalating when a decision is needed

- Proactive. You spot problems before anyone asks and bring solutions along with them.

- Trustworthy with sensitive information, including payroll

- Comfortable with multiple systems and quick to learn new tools

- Available to work hours that overlap with US Eastern Time, including Sundays

- Timely and collaborative in team communication, staying actively engaged and responsive during scheduled working hours

- Flags urgent booking or sitter issues immediately

- Eager to clarify details to ensure high-quality support; Asks questions when information is unclear rather than making assumptions



Nice to have: Experience in pet care, hospitality, or client-facing service businesses, and a genuine love of dogs and cats.



Details

Compensation: $6.00-$7.00/hour

Schedule: 20–25 hours/week, including a required Sunday shift during US Eastern Time. Exact schedule will be established during onboarding based on business needs.

Start date: Training begins early November



How to Apply

(remove the spaces)

To show us you read all the way through, please rename your introduction video title to your name and your favorite dog breed.

title: Lead Generation Role – Full Brief
description:
Role Overview

Your job is to identify and qualify independent music artists who show clear, measurable online activity.

You research artists, confirm they meet the required profile, gather basic catalog and contact information, and prepare clean handoff packages.

You do not contact or message the artists yourself. You pass verified leads to the next stage of the process.

This is a pure research and verification role.



Target Profile

Only work on artists who meet all of the following:



Independent

Not signed to a major record company or large corporate music group.

Look at the distributor or label listed on their releases. If it is a major (or major-owned), stop.

Location

Based outside the United States.

Focus regions include Southeast Asia, Eastern Europe, parts of Africa, Latin America, and similar markets.

If the country is unclear, flag it before continuing.

Activity Level

Must show real traction. Use the highest available numbers:

At least one track with significant YouTube views, or

Strong catalog performance on Spotify, or

A solid combination of both.



Publishing Status

The artist and their works must not already be registered for publishing.

You are required to check this thoroughly using the available public databases and credit information.

If clear publishing registration or administration is already in place, skip the artist.

Original Work

Focus on original material. Avoid pure covers, remixes, or tracks built heavily on other people’s compositions when the original rights are clearly controlled.





Research Process

Follow this order for every artist:



Confirm they are independent (check distributor / label credits).

Record current streaming and view numbers for their top tracks.

Thoroughly check whether the artist or their works are already registered for publishing.

Note release history and catalog size.

Gather available public contact points (social profiles,
 if listed, link pages).

Flag any obvious complications (multiple writers, existing administration, etc.).



Only prepare a handoff once the profile is clean and complete.



Required Information for Every Handoff

Each lead package must include:



Artist name

Key links (Spotify, YouTube, main social)

Location (best available)

Top tracks with activity numbers

Distributor / label shown on releases

Confirmation of publishing status check

Contact options found

Short notes on catalog size and any relevant observations



Incomplete packages are not accepted.



Performance Expectations



Quality over quantity. Clean, accurate leads matter more than volume.

Consistency and attention to detail.

Speed improves with practice, but accuracy comes first.

Track how complete and usable your handoffs are over time.





Tools

You will use publicly available platforms and any internal tools provided:



Streaming platforms (Spotify, YouTube)

Public music databases and credit pages

Search engines and social profiles

Any analytics access already set up for the team



Ask if something required is missing.



Important Rules



Do not contact artists.

Do not discuss internal criteria, processes, or purpose with anyone outside the team.

Keep all research internal until the handoff is complete.

Criteria exist to keep the pipeline focused and high-quality — follow them exactly.





Summary

Find independent artists with real activity who fit the location and profile rules.



Verify carefully, including a thorough check that they are not already registered for publishing.



Collect complete, usable information.



Hand off clean packages.

That is the full scope of the role.



Reply with the word “song” to confirm you have read and understood this brief.

- Research Skills: Ability to conduct thorough research and synthesise information into clear, compelling, and customer-focused narratives for B2B audiences.

title: Sales and Customer Support (Phone-based)
description:

• Fully remote, long-term opportunity with a growing UK e-commerce company

• Supportive management and collaborative team environment

9:00 AM to 5:00 PM UK Business Time (4:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine Time)

Role (Overview of the Position)

Handle routine admin tasks, monitor schedules, and support other departments so operations run smoothly and clients stay satisfied.

Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)





General VA Scope: Admin and Operations Support

Organize Digital Workspaces: Maintain orderly files, folders, and dashboards so teams can quickly access accurate, updated information.

Support Cross-Department Needs: Assist departments with admin tasks such as email drafts, scheduling, documentation, and follow-ups to keep collaboration smooth.

Maintain Task Efficiency: Track progress, follow up on pending items, and make sure deadlines are met without bottlenecks.

Call Logging and Report Management: Prepare, update, and maintain reports and call logs with accuracy, consistency, and timely updates so teams make well-informed decisions.

Dashboard Updates: Regularly update and monitor dashboards so KPIs are visible, reliable, and easy to track.

Tech VA Scope: Systems and Technical Support

Optimize Systems and Tools: Set up, manage, and troubleshoot digital platforms (CRMs, project management tools, automations, integrations).

Support Operations with Technology: Handle technical work such as site fixes, helpdesk tasks, data research, and technical reporting.

Increase Efficiency: Automate repetitive tasks, streamline workflows, and reduce bottlenecks through smart use of software.

Ensure Reliability: Provide technical stability, minimize downtime, and keep digital operations running for client campaigns and internal projects.

Shared Scope: Website, SEO, and Team Enablement

Website Management: Handle minor website updates, content uploads (text, images, blogs), plugins, landing pages, and tracking codes, plus overall website upkeep.

SEO-Related Tasks: Support keyword tracking, on-page updates, backlink updates, and directory campaigns to improve search visibility and rankings.

Documentation and Training: Create and update SOPs and how-to guides, and train the team on new tools and processes.

Enable Teams to Focus on Strategy: Free up managers, team leaders, and executives from admin-heavy and tech-heavy tasks so they can focus on growth and decision-making.





Results (Expected Accomplishments)



Data Accuracy and Reporting

Maintain 95%+ accuracy in reports, dashboards, call logs, and client tracking data (checked weekly).*

Why: Critical for decision-making and client trust.

Automation Efficiency

Implement 1+ automation improvements per quarter that save a minimum of 5 hours/month for the team.*

Why: Directly supports "Increase Efficiency" and reduces repetitive workload.

Proactive Improvements and Monitoring

Identify at least one admin efficiency improvement per quarter (workflow adjustment, reporting shortcut, organization upgrade).*

Identify potential tech risks (system failures, outdated tools, integration gaps) monthly and escalate with solutions.*

Why: Strengthens productivity and prevents crises before they happen.

Website and Platform Updates

Action 95% of minor website, content, and tech update requests (text, images, blogs, plugins, landing pages, tracking codes) within 48 hours.*

Why: Keeps the website current and campaigns running without delay.

Error, Bug, and Inconsistency Resolution

Troubleshoot and resolve 90% of technical issues (errors, integration failures, access problems) within 24 hours of report.*

Flag and resolve 95% of admin or reporting inconsistencies within 24 hours of discovery.*

Why: Keeps operations reliable and prevents bottlenecks.

Cross-Department Admin Support

Complete 90%+ of cross-department admin tasks (email drafts, scheduling, documentation, follow-ups) within agreed timelines.*

Why: Reduces workload for managers so teams can focus on strategy.

SOP Documentation

Create/update 2 to 3 SOPs or how-to guides per quarter, covering at least one admin process (e.g., Agency Analytics setup, reporting) and one tech process (e.g., Zapier workflows).*

Why: Ensures knowledge transfer and reduces dependency on individuals.

Tool Adoption and Training

Facilitate one mini-training or resource update monthly to ensure 80%+ team adoption of new tools or updates.*

Why: Keeps the team productive.

File and Data Organization

Ensure 100% of client folders, shared drives, and knowledge bases are updated and tagged weekly.*

Why: Supports knowledge base accuracy and easy access to information.

title: Cold Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of eCommerce experience and understands how online businesses, retailers, brands, wholesalers, marketplaces, and product-based businesses operate.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Conduct outbound prospecting through
, phone, LinkedIn, and other appropriate channels.

- Schedule qualified opportunities for the sales team where appropriate.

- Work closely with the sales team to ensure qualified leads are properly handed over.

- Track outreach activity and results.

- Test and improve messaging, targeting, and prospecting approaches.

- Research eCommerce markets, product categories, brands, retailers, and online businesses to identify new opportunities.

- Contribute ideas for new markets, industries, and prospecting opportunities.



REQUIREMENTS

- Minimum 5 years of eCommerce experience.

- 2+ years of experience in lead generation, cold calling, sales development, business development, telemarketing, or a similar role.

- Strong understanding of eCommerce and online retail.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Comfortable making cold calls and initiating conversations with businesses.

- Experience with cold
 and outbound prospecting.

- Strong internet research and prospecting skills.

- Able to identify relevant businesses and decision-makers.

- Confident in communicating with business owners, managers, and other decision-makers.

- Strong follow-up and organisational skills.

- Comfortable working with CRM systems and spreadsheets.

- Self-motivated and able to work independently.

- Detail-oriented and consistent with data entry and CRM updates.

- Comfortable working with targets and measurable KPIs.

- Willingness to learn and adapt messaging based on results.



E-COMMERCE EXPERIENCE



Your eCommerce experience should give you a good understanding of areas such as:

- Online retail

- eCommerce businesses and business models

- Marketplaces

- Product-based businesses

- Retailers and wholesalers

- Brands and distributors

- Product categories and pricing

- Inventory and stock

- Online product listings

- Shopify, Amazon, eBay, or similar platforms

- B2B and/or B2C eCommerce



Experience working with excess inventory, clearance stock, wholesale, liquidation, marketplaces, or retail inventory is highly desirable.



-EXPERIENCE WITH THESE TOOLS IS A PLUS

- GoHighLevel (GHL)

- LinkedIn

- Google Maps / Google Search

- Apollo or similar prospecting tools

-
 outreach platforms

- Google Sheets

- CRM systems

- Shopify

- Amazon Seller Central

- eBay

- Other eCommerce or marketplace platforms



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



You will be successful in this role if you can consistently:



- Find relevant prospects.

- Identify the right decision-makers.

- Reach prospects through effective outbound communication.

- Generate meaningful conversations.

- Create qualified sales opportunities.

- Maintain a healthy prospect pipeline.

- Follow up consistently.

- Produce measurable results from outbound activities.



We are looking for someone who understands that lead generation is more than collecting names and
 addresses.



The goal is to find the right businesses, understand their potential relevance, start conversations, and create genuine opportunities for the sales team.



WHO YOU ARE

- You are proactive, persistent, organised, and commercially minded.

- You have a strong understanding of eCommerce and know how to research markets, identify potential businesses, find the right people to contact, and start meaningful commercial conversations.

- You don't wait for leads to appear.

- You know how to find opportunities and create conversations.



If you enjoy eCommerce, prospecting, cold outreach, market research, and creating new business opportunities, we'd like to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

Schedule: 



Mon to Fri, split shift in Netherlands time (CET): 1.5 to 2 hours in the morning starting at 9:00 CET and 1.5 to 2 hours in the afternoon ending at 15:00 CET. All customer cases must be opened at 9:00 and closed before 15:00 CET.

requests with the people involved



Weekly:



-Review fixes (approx. 1 hour): handle and follow up on negative reviews through our automated
 flow

-Return fixes (approx. 4 hours): analyse return reasons and fix the causes together with Purchasing and Content, in two scheduled sessions per week

-Price updates (approx. 15 minutes): make scheduled price changes

-Data entry: keep product data, stock data and spreadsheets up to date in Google Sheets and our internal systems





Tools you will use



You’ll work daily in the 
 seller platform, our own partly automated internal dashboard, Slack for all team communication and escalations and Google Sheets. 

Full training on our dashboard and processes is provided.



What we’re looking for:



-Excellent written English

-At least 2 years of experience in customer support, preferably e-commerce (Amazon, Shopify, 
 or similar is a plus)

-Experience with marketplace seller portals (listings, product status, buy box) is a strong plus

-Strong attention to detail and accuracy

-Comfortable with Google Sheets (filters, basic formulas)

-Comfortable working in Slack and learning new internal tools quickly

-Proactive: you notice problems and follow up without being chased

-Comfortable using translation tools like DeepL (most of our customers write in Dutch)

-Available for a fixed split schedule in CET, every weekday

-Stable internet connection with a backup (mobile data or power bank), own laptop and a quiet workspace



Nice to have:



-Experience with 
 or other marketplace seller portals (Amazon Seller Central, Shopee, Lazada). Basic knowledge of Dutch is a bonus but not required.



What we offer



-A long-term, stable part-time remote role with a friendly international team, clear processes, room to grow into more hours and responsibility.



How to apply



-Your customer support and marketplace experience: which e-commerce platforms and seller portals you have worked with, and roughly how many customer cases you handled per day.

“Ik heb gisteren mijn bestelling ontvangen maar het product werkt niet. Dit is al de tweede keer. Ik wil mijn geld terug en ben erg ontevreden.”

title: Web & Brand Designer (part-time)
description:
Who we are

Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 25 people across the US, Europe and the Philippines.



Why we are hiring

Our website, our social channels and our brand assets have been built by different people at different times, and it shows. We want one designer who owns how Flow looks everywhere except in paid ads: the website pages we test, the social posts we publish, the templates the team uses, and the brand consistency across all of it.



What you will own

Website design. New sections for our product pages that we test, listicle and landing page layouts, handed to our developer in Figma.



Social media posts. Designed, on brand, on schedule.



Brand assets and templates. The files the rest of the team uses, so that what they produce looks like Flow.



 and SMS templates, and packaging design support together with our Head of Customer Experience.



Brand coherence. Same look, same feel, on every touchpoint.



Your first weeks: new product page sections for testing, a listicle structure, and a batch of social posts.



What this role is not

Paid social statics are made by a separate designer. Video is made by our editors. Brand strategy is not part of this role.



Who we are looking for

4+ years of design for DTC or consumer brands, with a portfolio that shows website, social and brand work.



Figma expert. You have handed designs to developers before and know what they need from you.



Comfortable with AI image tools. Blender is a bonus.



You take a brief, ask the right questions, and deliver in two rounds, not five.



Based in the Philippines or Eastern Europe, with a few hours of overlap with US Eastern working hours.



What is hard about this

We would rather you hear it now than in month three:



Briefs are sometimes a sentence long. Asking the right questions is part of the job.



Several people will give you feedback: the founders, the developer, later the Head of Customer Experience. You keep the brand consistent through all of it.



Part-time means prioritising. Twenty hours go to what moves the site and the brand, not to everything that gets asked.



The engagement

Type



Contractor, part-time, with an option to grow into full-time.



Time



20 hours a week.



Compensation



$750–1,000 per month for 20 hours, depending on experience.



Location



Remote, Philippines or Eastern Europe preferred.



Reports to



Our COO and co-founder; later our Head of Customer Experience.



Start



1 November 2026.



How to apply

Start your application with the word REISHI so we know you read the whole listing. Then send us:



- A portfolio with at least ten pieces, including website or landing page work and social posts.



- One design you made that was then built by a developer. What did the developer get from you, and what came back with questions?



- Your rate for 20 hours a week and the hours you are usually online.

title: Junior Virtual Assistant - Creators & Community (Full Training, No Experience Needed)
description:
Do you scroll Instagram and always notice which videos make you stop - and wonder why? Then this could be your job.



We are a fast-growing Danish e-commerce company behind KidsBuddy, a smartwatch for kids that gives children freedom without a smartphone and gives parents peace of mind. Our best-performing ads are made by real Danish parents and UGC creators, and we're building a creator community around that. We're looking for a Junior Virtual Assistant to help run it. No experience needed - our founder will personally train you in everything.



WHO WE ARE

We are a small, fully remote team working closely together every day in Slack. We have a weekly team meeting where everyone joins, and despite the distance it feels like a real team - people help each other, celebrate wins together, and nobody is left alone with a problem. Several of our team members are based in the Philippines and have been with us for a long time.



We have high expectations and we're honest about that - but we match them with stable long-term work and a leader who invests time in helping you grow.



WHAT THE ROLE IS

Most of your day will be spent with our creators: finding them, persuading them, motivating them and helping them make great videos. Alongside that, you'll handle some operational tasks. During your training, you'll work closely with the founder, who will teach you how everything works. As you prove yourself, more responsibility comes your way, and if you perform well there's a real path to owning our entire creator program.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Creators & community

- Find new UGC creators on Instagram and Trybe and persuade them to join our program

- Share new briefs and winning hooks and angles with creators, and keep them making more videos

- Review submitted videos against the brief and give clear, kind feedback

- Learn which videos, hooks and angles perform in our ads, and help turn that into better briefs

- Build a real creator community: group chats, broadcasts, recognition and small rewards

- Support our influencer partnerships with coordination, follow-ups and tracking

- Deliver approved content to our ads agency every day and keep our creator tracker updated



Operations & admin

- Follow up on tasks and make sure things get done

- Keep your tasks organized in ClickUp and send a daily EOD report

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automations) to work faster and smarter



WHO YOU ARE

- Your English is excellent, written and spoken. This is the most important requirement.

- You know Instagram inside out: DMs, stories, reels and how creators think

- You are naturally persuasive - you enjoy turning a "maybe" into a "yes" without being pushy

- You are curious about why some videos perform and others don't

- You are comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to write natural messages in Danish

- You take ownership, pay attention to details, and follow processes carefully

- When something is unclear, you try, you Google, you use AI, and then you ask smart questions

- You have reliable internet and backup power

- Experience with social media, influencers or UGC is a plus, but not required. Attitude is everything.



WHAT YOU'LL GET

- Hands-on training directly from the founder on our creator program, Trybe and our creative process

- Learning how real e-commerce ads are made, from the inside

- Hands-on experience with AI tools that most virtual assistants never get to use

- A friendly, supportive team that always has your back

- $4-8/hour starting pay with real raises when you deliver

- Christmas bonus every year

- A real path to owning our entire creator program



WORKING HOURS

Full-time, 40 hours/week. Your schedule is flexible, but at least 6 of your hours must fall between 8 AM and 5 PM Danish time, and you must be logged in no later than 9 AM Danish time every weekday. Denmark switches between summer and winter time, so in Philippine time that means logging in by 3 PM during Danish summer time (end of March to end of October) and by 4 PM during Danish winter time. If you are currently studying, your classes must not overlap with these hours.



STRUCTURE

The trial period is paid. You get full training in your first weeks.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF YOUR APPLICATION

In your video introduction (see below), tell us about ONE time you convinced someone who first said no - in work, school or your personal life. What was holding them back, and what did you say?



HOW TO APPLY

title: Asset & Lease Manager
description:
Asset & Lease Manager

Own the administration of a multi-site U.S. retail lease portfolio: abstract leases, track critical dates, verify every landlord charge before it is paid, and recover overbilled CAM and tax charges.



Work Setup

Full-time, Monday–Friday, night shift

Must have a computer with a webcam

Reliable high-speed internet



What You'll Do

Abstract every executed lease and amendment (rent, escalations, CAM/tax/insurance terms, options, notice windows, exclusives, co-tenancy) into the lease database.

Maintain the critical date calendar (options, renewals, termination rights, TI deadlines, insurance renewals, estoppels) and give advance notice.

Route and file leases, amendments, estoppels, SNDAs and consents, and keep an indexed digital lease file.

Set up rent records at commencement and keep escalations, amendments and abatements current.

Validate every monthly billing (base rent, CAM, tax, insurance, percentage rent) against the lease before payment, and prepare the payment file for Accounting.

Manage the outsourced CAM and tax audit, review findings against the lease, and track approved claims through to credit or refund.

Screen year-end reconciliations on receipt and correct errors right away.

Track real estate tax bills and assessments, verify pro-rata shares, and flag protest candidates.

Issue and maintain certificates of insurance for every location to each lease's requirements.

Monitor landlord obligations and put landlords on notice when they are unmet.

Maintain W-9s, landlord and property manager records, and payment instructions, with verified controls on any banking changes.

Support franchisor and lender consent, estoppel and reporting requests.

Act as the day-to-day contact for property managers on statements, reconciliations, certificates and documents.

Prepare and file TI allowance draw packages and track them through to receipt.

Support back-charge claims and portfolio events such as closures, relocations, assignments and subleases.

Keep the lease database accurate, and produce recurring reports (critical dates, rent roll, occupancy cost, audit savings, insurance compliance).

Write and maintain SOPs, and help define, train and supervise a future associate role.



What We're Looking For

4+ years in U.S. retail or commercial lease administration, lease accounting or property accounting, ideally with multi-site portfolios

Ability to read and accurately abstract U.S. shopping-center leases, including CAM, tax and insurance pass-throughs, caps, exclusions, options and notice requirements

Working knowledge of CAM and real estate tax reconciliations, with the ability to spot improper charges and hold a position with landlords or audit firms

Experience managing certificates of insurance against lease-specific requirements

Advanced Excel

Excellent written and spoken English for direct, professional correspondence with U.S. landlords and property managers

Exceptional accuracy and follow-through, and comfort owning a deadline calendar where a missed date has real financial consequences

Preferred: a degree in Accounting, Finance, Real Estate, Business or Law

Preferred: experience with a lease administration platform, e-signature tools and an ERP/AP system

Preferred: experience supporting a growing portfolio (new openings, TI collection) or working with a U.S.-based team from offshore

title: PERFORMANCE VIDEO EDITOR
description:
MAKE SURE TO APPLY HERE: 



Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewellery brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for traveller's, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.



This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.



We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.



You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.



Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.



It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.



Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.



What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.



Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.



Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

We’re looking for an experienced, all-round design lead who we can trust with almost any design problem, from product imagery and packaging to advertising creatives and reviewing the work of other designers.



This is a senior, hands-on role for someone with strong commercial taste who can take ownership rather than simply wait for design tickets and instructions.



What You’ll Own

Product imagery for PDPs, packshots, and lifestyle creatives

Packaging design

Occasional Meta and static advertising creatives

Text-in-image creatives with strong typography and composition

Who We’re Looking For

Strong experience in ecommerce or commercial product design

A portfolio demonstrating product-focused work, not primarily logos or branding projects

Excellent visual judgment, composition, typography, and attention to detail

Strong AI image-generation and editing skills

Experience creating convincing AI product/lifestyle imagery

title: Junior AI Graphic Designer
description:
MAKE SURE TO APPLY HERE: 



AI Graphic Designer

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $3 - $6 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewellery brand selling collectible travel charms. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're now scaling our image ad creatives to match.



You'll join a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators, working closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. This role exists because our image ad output needs to catch up with our video engine, and you'll help build that side of the creative machine.



That's the opportunity: you're not joining a mature department to take instructions. You're building the static side of a content operation that has already proved it can do a quarter billion views.



Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Designer.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. A Senior Designer here owns the visual direction of our image ads: you test your own concepts rather than executing briefs, you expand our prompt library, and you set the standard the rest of the team designs to.



It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.



What You'll Earn

Base: $3 - $6 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning ad. When a creative you made hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it.

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within 1–2 weeks, a successful hire is producing 10/10-quality AI image ads by following our process, creating work that passes review without rework and matches the Exchange Life look. From there, success means consistent output, images that perform on ads, and proactive suggestions that improve the process itself.



Core Responsibilities

Generate AI product images using our internal prompts, templates, and workflows

Overlay headlines and copy in Photoshop, matching Exchange Life's visual style

Iterate on designs based on feedback from the team and ad performance

Organize and manage creative assets, keeping our AI image library clean and up to date

Communicate proactively about bottlenecks, capacity, and output

Must-Haves

Intermediate Adobe Photoshop skills (this is your main tool)

Solid grasp of text placement and typography for ad creatives

A portfolio showing clean, polished design work

Able to follow a creative brief and established process independently

Reliable communicator who shares their opinion and flags issues early

Clear written and spoken English

Stable internet connection

Nice-to-Haves

AI image generation experience (Higgsfield or similar tools)

Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or social media ad creative

What You'll Learn Here

AI creative is the fastest-moving skill in marketing right now, and most designers are learning it on personal projects with no feedback loop. You'll learn it on real ad spend.



Direct access to ad performance data on your own creatives, so you learn what converts, not just what looks good

Our internal prompt library and workflows, plus the paid AI tools to run them

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software

A portfolio of creatives with performance numbers attached, which is the thing that gets designers hired at the next level

Not a Fit If

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

You want to make art rather than ads that perform

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you deliver and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools you'll use: Photoshop, AI image generation tools (Higgsfield or similar), our internal prompt library

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

title: Production Admin Coordinator (Apparel, Remote, Purchase Orders and Production Admin)
description:
This is a great long-term opportunity to join a globally renowned Australian denim and apparel group, with multiple well-known brands sold around the world. We're hiring a Production Admin Coordinator for a brand-new role in their production team, with real opportunity to grow as the team and the business expand.



About the role

You'll provide dedicated administrative and transactional support to the production function, taking the high-volume system, documentation and tracking work off the production managers so they can focus on planning, supplier management and analysis.



The role is defined by accuracy, consistency and turnaround. Your work feeds directly into supplier orders, delivery schedules, finance and the sales team, so data integrity is the single most important part of the job.



You'll own the admin side of the purchase order lifecycle: from raising the PO and sending it to the factory or supplier, through amendments and ex-factory changes, to delivery into the distribution centre. A big part of the day is supplier communication, with 30 to 40 supplier
s most mornings (barcode requests, order questions, site queries and more).



You'll report to the Senior Production Manager and work closely with one other team member day to day, as well as the Production Manager, Product & Denim Manager, Logistics Manager and the supplier base.



What you'll do



Purchase order administration

- Raise bulk, SMS and recut purchase orders in CIN7, accurately matching approved planning and sales close files.

- Upload FOB and international costs, making sure all negotiated discounts and surcharges are correctly applied.

- Add freight and duty costs to all Australian purchase orders.

- Action approved amendments (cancellations, additions, colour and quantity changes) and keep system data aligned.

- Maintain purchase order data through to delivery, including updates when ex-factory dates change or are delayed.



Delivery schedules and data integrity

- Support delivery schedule creation and maintain it as bookings, handovers and revised dates come through.

- Build and maintain the delivery tracker up to the point stock arrives in the DC.

- Run routine data validation checks across CIN7, planning files and delivery schedules, and flag discrepancies.

- Maintain brand cancellation lists and distribute them to the agreed stakeholders.

- Complete the weekly Magellan portal upload and keep the portal current.

- Export CIN7 barcode data for supplier plan sheets and validate recommended retail prices against brand documents.

- Work in supplier Excel files every day (each supplier has its own).



Recut and tracker management

- Place approved recut purchase orders and provide fabric usage detail for the fabric stock list.

- Navigate the PLM (WFX) and export seasonal style data into Excel for recuts.

- Own the recut tracker, uploading purchase order data and ETAs so the sales team has live visibility.

- Keep all production trackers current, accurate and ready for review at agreed checkpoints.



SMS and seasonal administration

- Prepare SMS order templates and raise SMS purchase orders.

- Produce SMS packing lists and split final packing lists by supplier.

- Support seasonal handover documentation to customer service and the international regions.



Supplier and compliance document support

- Chase suppliers for routine documentation (scope certificates, fibre certification, audit and corrective action plan responses) and file it correctly.

- Log compliance documentation in the relevant portals and escalate anything overdue or non-compliant.

- Follow up outstanding supplier confirmations and acknowledgements.



Supplier communication

- Work through the daily supplier inbox so it no longer lands on the production managers.

- Liaise directly with factories and suppliers by
, phone and video call.

- Capture supplier updates, including ex-factory changes and delays and quality issues on P1 and P2 samples, and feed them back concisely.

- Share ex-factory delays promptly with everyone affected, including the sales team, so major retail accounts hear early.



Reporting support

- Prepare recurring reports and data extracts for the production team.

- Compile inputs for margin, DIFOT and factory performance reporting.

- Complete ad hoc administrative tasks as directed.



Not part of this role: creating or maintaining product data (design team), logistics administration and freight forwarder liaison (logistics coordinator), and top-line supply planning.



How success is measured

- Data accuracy across purchase order and delivery schedule entry.

- Turnaround time against agreed service levels for PO placement and amendments.

- Recut tracker, delivery schedules and Magellan portal up to date at agreed checkpoints.

- Low rework rate.

- Supplier document chases closed on time.

- Administrative load released from the production managers.



What you'll need

- 2+ years in a production, supply chain, sourcing or order administration role, ideally in apparel.

- Strong working knowledge of ERP or PLM systems, including managing purchase orders in an ERP (CIN7, NetSuite, SAP or similar).

- Advanced spreadsheet (Excel) skills and proven accuracy with high-volume data.

- Excellent written English and clear, professional supplier communication.

- Excellent spoken English and comfort on phone and video calls with suppliers.

- Highly organised, able to work to deadlines across time zones with minimal supervision.

- Comfortable asking for clarification rather than assuming: accuracy over speed.

- Strong note taking and quick to learn a new system.

- Fully present across a 9am to 5pm working day, comfortable on camera and quick to respond.



Nice to have

- CIN7 or WFX experience.

- An understanding of logistics.



About you

You bring high energy, enthusiasm and engagement. You take the initiative to solve problems and answer your own questions from your notes and recorded training videos, while knowing when to escalate. You keep people updated early, especially when dates slip.



Training

You'll be trained by the Senior Production Manager, with recorded training videos to refer back to. CIN7 experience isn't required on day one: strong note taking makes the difference.



Why join

- A great long-term, full-time opportunity, not a short contract

- Work behind the scenes for a globally renowned denim and apparel group with multiple well-known brands

- Real opportunity to grow: build your skills in CIN7, PLM and international production, and take on more as the team expands

- Structured training from the Senior Production Manager, plus recorded videos to refer back to

- A supportive, organised production team that values accuracy and early communication

- Fully remote, Monday to Friday



Hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Melbourne time. That's 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time while Australian daylight saving is on (October to April), and 7:00am to 3:00pm Philippine time from April to October.



How to apply

Please put "PO Admin" in your subject line so we know you've read the whole ad. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

Send your CV and a short note on the purchase order or ERP systems you've used and the volume of POs you've managed.

Customer Service Manager (E-commerce)



Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced, operations-minded E-commerce Customer Service Manager to lead our customer support team and elevate our post-purchase experience. In this role, you will oversee day-to-day operations across all digital customer channels 
, Live Chat, Social Media, SMS, and Phone), optimize support technology stacks, and directly drive customer retention and brand loyalty.



The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) retail, deep technical familiarity with helpdesk software and e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify / Amazon), and a data-driven approach to coaching and process optimization.



Key Responsibilities



Team Leadership & Operations

Design, maintain, and update the repository of
 response templates, macros, and brand tone guidelines to ensure consistency across the team.

Quality Assurance & Analytics

Conduct regular quality assurance (QA) audits of customer tickets to ensure consistency, tone accuracy, and policy compliance.

Analyze recurring customer pain points and provide regular feedback reports to executive leadership to inform product and site improvements.

Demonstrated experience scaling digital support operations across multiple channels (chat,

Deep understanding of e-commerce fulfillment processes, reverse logistics (returns platforms like Loop or Happy Returns), and payment gateways.

Customer Empathy: Passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and turning negative moments into brand loyalty.

JOB SUMMARY:

As our Amazon Brand Manager, you'll be the one steering how our products perform on Amazon day to day — from pricing and promotions to ad campaigns and everything in between. You'll keep an eye on our listings, spot opportunities to grow revenue, and help us stay ahead in our category.





RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage daily sales operations for assigned products, including pricing, promotions, and advertising campaigns

- Oversee product listings and identify new revenue opportunities within respective categories

- Monitor product performance to drive consistent sales growth and stronger category rankings

- Conduct in-depth product analysis and research market trends/competitors to guide strategic decisions

- Collaborate with the inventory planning team to manage promotions and excess inventory

- Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and confidentiality across all deliverables

• Strong brand management experience — from listing optimization and A+ Content to product launches and brand positioning

• PPC experience is a plus, but not required

• Strong analytical, data-driven decision-making skills

• Solid market research experience

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong documentation and time management skills

• This role is strictly for applicants based within NCR or nearby areas (e.g., Bulacan, Rizal).

• You'll need to send a portfolio with a real ASIN you've personally handled from launch to finish (brand/product can be blurred), backed by substantial data — think sales or bestseller ranking graphs, not just a screenshot. If NDA-restricted or you no longer have account access, a short video walkthrough explaining the work and results is acceptable instead.

• Be ready to walk through and explain the actual performance data behind that ASIN during the interview — conversion rate, ACOS, organic vs. paid sales split. This will be a substantial part of the conversation, so come prepared to speak to real numbers, not general claims.





SETUP:

• Full-time, 9AM to 6PM PHT

• Uses Time Doctor for time tracking

• Own equipment needed (Laptop, Mouse, Earphones/Headphones)

• Stable internet connection, with a readily available backup connection

• Full-time contractual employment (renewal contract based on performance)
