title: TikTok Operator (Shop & Account)
description:
[Read properly before applying]

[Do not apply if you do not meet the requirements or you do not possess the ample experience]

[This is NOT a VIDEO EDITOR job opening]

[This is NOT a CONTENT CREATOR job opening]

---



We're hiring a TikTok Operator to run and grow our U.S. TikTok Shop. This isn't a content or social media job — it's a business role. You'll own the whole channel: TikTok Shop, creators/affiliates, content, ads, livestreams, and the numbers behind all of it.



We want a builder! Someone who either launched a TikTok Shop from zero and made it succeed, or took over a shop that wasn't performing and turned it around. It needs to be *their* win — not a channel they just helped run while someone else called the shots.



You'll start hands-on, with room to build and lead a team as the channel grows.





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

- Create simple processes so the work can run smoothly as the team grows

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

- Can work independently, solve problems, and take full ownership of results





NON-NEGOTIABLES



- Based within Luzon, and willing to travel to NCR whenever the CEO is in Manila to check in with the team

- Was the main driver — not just a helper — behind a TikTok Shop's growth or launch. This means one of:

 [1] Launched a TikTok Shop from scratch and built it into a success (or at least got it to a strong state before leaving the company/client), or...

 [2] Took over a TikTok Shop with little to no traction (low sales/GMV) and turned it around

- Can clearly explain *their own* strategy and decisions behind that growth — not just point to results the shop achieved under someone else's plan

- Strong track record of driving measurable sales growth and improving overall TikTok channel performance

- Strong understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and its key sales/growth drivers





NICE TO HAVE



- Background in health, wellness, beauty, personal care, supplements, medical products, sports, or other regulated consumer categories

- Experience managing TikTok at significant sales/GMV scale, or across multiple brands/shops

- Experience building or leading a TikTok/e-commerce team, or managing large creator networks

- Direct experience working with TikTok account managers or platform reps

- Experience managing TikTok alongside Amazon or other major e-commerce channels

title: Fulfillment Coordinator | DTC Supplement Subscription Brand
description:
We’re a fast-scaling, founder-run DTC subscription brand. Our CS team currently has two CS agents, and we’re looking for a third to join us as a Fulfillment Coordinator. If you’ve worked at a subscription-based brand before, day one will look pretty familiar. And if you’re the kind of CS pro who knows when to use your best judgment, thinks two steps ahead, and knows when to escalate rather than guess, keep reading.



You’ll be the person who makes sure no customer is left wondering where their order is. This role is outbound: instead of waiting for customers to write in, you’ll reach out to them first when a delivery fails and work with them until it’s resolved.



What you’ll be doing:



- Maintain our Google Sheets database of failed deliveries

- Export in transit, exception, failed attempt, and expired orders from Parcel Panel, clean up the data, and log it in the database

- Reach out to our fulfillment partner for more information on each order issue

- Contact customers and offer a resolution

- Own the conversation with the customer from start to resolution

- Process orders and partial refunds in Shopify

- Log every resolution in the database

- Send daily, weekly, and monthly reports to the CS Manager and founders



Good to know: this role starts fully outbound. As our volume grows, you’ll also help the CS team with inbound tickets in Commslayer, so experience with customer support inboxes is a plus.



We have a documented process that covers how to handle nearly everything you’ll run into, so you’re never starting from scratch or guessing at what to say. Your job is to follow the current process closely, flag any unique issues that fall outside our SOP, and help us sharpen it over time. We’ll also meet regularly to review KPIs and do 1:1 coaching to support your growth in the role.



What we’re looking for:



- 3 years in customer service or support, ideally with a DTC or subscription brand

- Comfortable with Google Sheets (organizing, cleaning, and logging data) and working in Slack for team communication

- Experience with helpdesk tools (we use Commslayer, and we’ll train you on it)

- Organized, detail-oriented, and good at following up until a case is closed

- Reliable with a fixed schedule: you show up on time, every shift



The details

Type: Part-time, fixed shift

Schedule: 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM PHT, Monday to Friday

Reports to: CS Manager

Pay: $3/hour (trial), $4/hour after



How to apply: 

Reply to this listing with the subject line “Fulfillment Coordinator - [YOUR NAME]” and answer the following:



1. Which helpdesk platforms have you used?

2. Briefly share your experience handling a failed delivery. What was the problem, what resolution did you offer, and what was the outcome?

3. How comfortable are you with Google Sheets? Share an example of how you’ve used it for tracking or reporting.

4. Tell us about a time you were proactive in a past role. What happened, and what was the outcome?

5. Can you confirm you’re available to work the schedule listed above?



Applications that don’t follow this format will not be shortlisted.

description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Negentropy Limited is a Hong Kong–based social marketing agency operating in the fast-paced e-commerce space. We work with performance-driven teams focused on execution, speed, and results.



We are not a “chill” company. We are a high-accountability environment where people are expected to deliver, improve, and take ownership daily.



THE ROLE

We are hiring a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Virtual Media Buying Assistant who can support advertising operations through data tracking, reporting, documentation, and campaign-related administrative support.



This role is for someone who:

- Takes ownership without being chased

- Communicates clearly and professionally

- Handles sensitive business information with professionalism and discretion

- Thrives in a structured, performance-based environment

If you need constant reminders, supervision, or struggle to stay organized—this role is not for you.



ROLE OVERVIEW

-Salary: ₱18,000 – ₱22,000 / month

-Employment Type: Contractual (6 months, renewable based on performance)

-Work Setup 100% Remote (Full-time)

-Schedule: Morning Shift (Philippine Time) | 5 days/week, 8 hours/day

-Ideal For: Organized self-starters who value structure, clarity, and steady execution.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

-Executive Support: Assist with reports, presentations, ad-hoc projects, and executive priorities while keeping information strictly confidential.

-Data & Performance Tracking: Track advertising/campaign metrics, update records, and maintain clean spreadsheet data.

-Documentation & File Management: Organize records, build clear tracking systems, and ensure high accuracy before submitting work.

-Team Coordination: Collaborate with internal teams to complete projects efficiently.



QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or any related field (fresh graduates, SHS graduates, and undergraduates are welcome)

-Experience: Background as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or Admin Assistant is a plus.

-Technical Skills: Proficient in Google Workspace (especially Google Sheets).

- Communication: Strong written and spoken English.

- Core Skills: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and skilled at prioritizing tasks with minimal supervision.



IDEAL CANDIDATE FIT

This role is a great fit if you:

-Thrive in structured environments with clear processes and expectations.

-Value high accuracy, thorough documentation, and strong time management.

-Communicate proactively and build trust through consistent performance.

- Can commit fully to a dedicated daytime schedule without conflicting obligations.



Technical Requirements (Work-from-Home)

-Internet: Stable connection (50–100 Mbps minimum)

-PC / Windows: Intel i5 (or equivalent), 8GB RAM, 256GB storage minimum

-Mac: Apple M1 chip / Intel i5, 8GB unified memory, 256GB SSD minimum



Note: This position requires exclusive full-time commitment during scheduled working hours. It is not suitable for those looking for loose structure, flexible schedules, or balancing multiple commitments.

title: Generalist Technical Artist
description:
About the Role



B2B, remote, long-term, full-time job. This is a senior, highly specialized individual contributor role for a Creative Technical Artist with strong game design intuition and the ability to build, polish, and tune gameplay using lightweight, game-focused coding (“vibe coding”). The role focuses on building, iterating, and polishing interactive HTML5 playable ads, where visuals, mechanics, and overall game feel must come together quickly and at a high quality bar. The successful candidate will operate as a one-person function, supporting key processes and working closely with the team.

Responsibilities



Create, adapt, and polish optimized 2D and 3D assets for playable ads

Work in Blender to edit and optimize models, adjust materials, lighting, scale, and pivots

Export game-ready assets (GLB, textures)

Ensure visual clarity, consistency, and performance on mobile devices

Write and modify JavaScript / TypeScript to control gameplay behavior, tune timing, feedback, and interaction flow

Connect visuals to interaction logic

Read and safely modify existing game codebases

Use code as a creative tool to shape game feel

Leverage AI coding tools to accelerate iteration while maintaining full understanding and control

Requirements



3+ years of professional experience as a game artist, technical artist, or interactive artist

2+ years of hands-on experience with Blender creating game-ready 3D assets

Proven experience producing real-time 2D and/or 3D assets for games or interactive applications

Strong understanding of game mechanics, player feedback, and interaction flow

2+ years of hands-on experience working with a game engine such as Unity or Unreal Engine

Experience implementing or supporting gameplay mechanics within a game engine environment

Experience integrating art assets into game engines and resolving technical issues

About the Company



A leading interactive media company specializing in engaging and high-quality playable advertisements.

Assignment

2

First Manager Interview

Second Manager Interview

HR Interview

title: Junior Virtual Assistant - Trained by the Founder (No Experience Needed)
description:
Are you someone who learns fast, takes ownership, and wants more than a paycheck? Keep reading.



We are a fast-growing Danish e-commerce company behind KidsBuddy, a smartwatch for kids that gives children freedom without a smartphone and gives parents peace of mind. We're looking for a Junior Virtual Assistant to join our team. No experience needed - our founder will personally train you in everything.



WHO WE ARE

We are a small, fully remote team working closely together every day in Slack. We have a weekly team meeting where everyone joins, and despite the distance it feels like a real team - people help each other, celebrate wins together, and nobody is left alone with a problem. Several of our team members are based in the Philippines and have been with us for a long time.



We have high expectations and we're honest about that - but we match them with stable long-term work and a leader who invests time in helping you grow. If you do good work here, you will be seen, appreciated, and given more responsibility.



WHAT THE ROLE IS

This is not one narrow job. You'll support two areas of the business: our creator community and our day-to-day operations. During your training, you'll work closely with the founder, who will teach you both. As you prove yourself, more responsibility comes your way, and if you perform well there's a real path to owning our entire creator program.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Creator community & influencer support

- Support our UGC creator program on Trybe: reach out to new creators on Instagram and Trybe and persuade them to join

- Share briefs and winning angles, review submitted videos against the brief and give clear, kind feedback

- Keep creators motivated and engaged through group chats, broadcasts, recognition and small rewards

- Support our influencer partnerships with coordination, follow-ups and tracking

- Deliver approved content to our ads agency and keep our creator tracker updated



Operations & admin

title: Procurement and Logistics Manager
description:
Procurement & Logistics Manager 



Position Overview



We are seeking a highly analytical, proactive, and hands-on Procurement & Logistics Manager with specialized experience in the Amazon ecosystem (FBA/FBM). In this role, you will oversee end-to-end supply chain operations, from global vendor sourcing and purchase order management to international freight forwarding, 3PL hub management, and inbound distribution into Amazon Fulfillment Centers.



Your primary focus will be maintaining optimal stock levels, protecting inventory health metrics (IPI score), optimizing total landed costs, and building resilient supplier partnerships to support scalable e-commerce growth.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Inventory & FBA Operations Management

Manage daily FBA inventory workflows within Amazon Seller Central (and/or Vendor Central), including shipping plan creation, box content information, pallet specifications, and tracking inbound shipments.

Continuously monitor and optimize Inventory Performance Index (IPI) scores, restock limits, capacity limits, and aged inventory metrics to minimize overage and storage fees while preventing stockouts.

Ensure 100% compliance with Amazon prep, labeling, packaging, and routing requirements to eliminate prep chargebacks, processing delays, or vendor chargebacks.

Coordinate stock transfers between 3PL warehouses and Amazon FCs based on regional velocity, seasonal spikes, and FC receiving lead times.

2. Sourcing, Procurement & Vendor Management

Lead end-to-end purchase order (PO) generation, issuing, and status tracking with overseas and domestic manufacturing partners.

Negotiate pricing, minimum order quantities (MOQs), payment terms, and production lead times with suppliers to optimize cash flow and gross margins.

Establish supplier KPI dashboards to evaluate factory performance regarding defect rates, on-time delivery rates, and order fulfillment accuracy.

Identify secondary sourcing options for critical high-velocity SKUs to mitigate single-supplier dependency risks.

3. Global Logistics & Freight Coordination

Oversee international freight forwarding operations (Ocean FCL/LCL, Air Freight, Express Parcel, and DDP/FOB shipments) from factory gates to domestic destinations.

Partner with customs brokers and freight partners to ensure accurate HTS code classification, duty/tariff compliance, and smooth customs clearance.

Calculate, audit, and optimize total landed costs (unit cost + freight + duties + 3PL + Amazon fulfillment fees) to drive bottom-line profitability.

4. Demand Planning & Inventory Forecasting

Build and maintain dynamic demand forecasting models using historical sales velocity, organic search rankings, marketing campaigns, and seasonal events (e.g., Prime Day, Q4 Holiday Season).

Establish target reorder points (ROP), safety stock levels, and replenishment schedules across all product lines.

Perform weekly/monthly inventory reconciliations across Seller Central, 3PL physical stock, and internal ERP/inventory systems.



Qualifications & Skill Requirements



Required Experience

3–5+ years of direct experience in procurement, supply chain, or logistics for an e-commerce brand.

Must have hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central (Inbound Shipping Plans, FBA Inventory Dashboard, Inventory Performance Index, Restock Limits).

Proven track record managing international freight logistics (specifically Asia-to-US/EU shipping lanes, customs, and ocean/air freight).

Strong command of Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions: VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, forecasting models).

Experience working with third-party logistics (3PL) providers and prep centers.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience using supply chain software or ERP tools (e.g., NetSuite, Katana, InventoryLab, RestockPro, or similar).

Knowledge of multi-channel fulfillment models (Walmart Marketplace, Shopify Direct-to-Consumer, TikTok Shop).



How to Apply

Interested candidates should send a message with the subject: “Overqualified for coffee runs, perfect for Procurement and Logistics.” The cover letter should consist of your years of experience related to the job post. Send it together with your resume link.

title: Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant
description:
Company: MNJ Trading

Location: Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About MNJ Trading



MNJ Trading is an import and export company serving customers throughout the South Pacific region. Our customers operate primarily in the hospitality, industrial, and commercial sectors.



We help customers source suitable products, identify competitive suppliers, prepare quotations, coordinate orders, and arrange delivery to their destination.



About the Role



We are looking for a practical, organized, and detail-oriented Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant.



This is not a role based only on writing
s or speaking confidently. You will be expected to research products, compare suppliers, check specifications, calculate shipping volumes, prepare accurate quotations, follow up on orders, and keep information properly organized.



Our selection process includes a practical work assessment based on the actual responsibilities of the role.



Main Responsibilities:

- Research products based on customer requirements.

- Find and compare suitable suppliers.

- Verify product specifications, pricing, availability, MOQ, lead time, warranty, and delivery conditions.

- Request missing information from suppliers.

- Prepare supplier comparison sheets.

- Calculate carton quantities, weights, dimensions, CBM, and estimated shipping costs.

- Prepare accurate customer quotations.

- Coordinate orders with suppliers, warehouses, freight forwarders, and customers.

- Monitor order and shipment progress.

- Maintain organized records, spreadsheets, invoices, packing lists, and shipping documents.

- Identify missing or conflicting information before it becomes a problem.

- Provide clear updates to management and customers.

- Manage several requests according to urgency and commercial importance.



What Good Performance Looks Like



A successful team member:

- Checks details instead of making unsupported assumptions.

- Understands the difference between the lowest price and the best commercial option.

- Can identify when a product does not fully meet the customer’s requirements.

- Uses spreadsheet formulas correctly.

- Keeps source links, calculations, and records easy to verify.

- Communicates delays and problems early.

- Follows instructions and meets deadlines.

- Takes ownership of tasks through completion.

- Asks specific questions when information is missing.

- Produces accurate work without requiring constant supervision.



Required Skills

- Strong online product and supplier research skills.

- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Ability to compare prices and commercial terms.

- Confidence working with quantities, dimensions, weights, and CBM.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Clear written English.

- Ability to organize files and information.

- Good judgment when handling incomplete or conflicting information.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently.



Experience in procurement, sourcing, logistics, import/export, hospitality supplies, industrial supplies, or quotation preparation is an advantage.



Application Process



The process consists of:

- Initial application review

- MNJ Trading Practical Work Assessment 

- A short interview and live work verification

- Reference checks, if applicable.



Generic cover letters will not receive additional points. We are more interested in clear evidence of how you work.



How to Apply



Please submit:

- Brief Introduction why you're best fit for this role

- One redacted example of a supplier comparison, quotation, logistics spreadsheet, or similar document you personally prepared.



Your answers to the questions below.

1. Describe one product you previously sourced. What information did you verify before recommending a supplier?

2. Tell us about a mistake or discrepancy you found in an invoice, quotation, order, or shipping document. What did you do?

3. If a supplier provides a low price but does not confirm the required specifications, how would you handle it?



Please use the subject line:

Application – Operations Assistant – [Your Full Name]



Applications that progress to the next stage will receive the practical assessment instructions.

description:
Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.

Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.

- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- We'll agree on your final schedule during the hiring process - it must be sustainable long-term

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Fluent, professional English

- Clear spoken communication

- Emotional intelligence

- Be calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE

- Account Management

- Coaching

- Content strategy

HOW TO APPLY

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.

- Great Work-Life Balance: Sustainable hours with no graveyard shifts.

- Professional Growth: Accelerate your skill set through regular feedback and advanced training.



HOW TO APPLY

/to/O40RINeW



Important note: Put "CFM" + [Your Name & Family Name] in the "Name" field in the form.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer – Colourful Stickman/Cartoon Style (Long-Term)
description:
I am looking for a thumbnail designer for a YouTube project!



Reference style: Reference thumbnails will be shared in messages once you’ve shown me some of your work.



Project description:

I run a faceless YouTube explainer channel that uses colourful 2D stickman animation. I’m looking for a reliable designer to create eye-catching thumbnails that make people want to click.



Volume: 2 to 3 thumbnails per week to start, increasing as the channel grows

What I provide: the video title, topic and script, plus any ideas I have for the thumbnail

What you do: create the full thumbnail from start to finish, including the stickman characters, background, objects and any text

Turnaround: 24 to 48 hours per thumbnail

Revisions: small revisions may be needed, especially on the first few while we lock in the style

Workflow: Trello for tasks, Google Drive for files, and 
 or WhatsApp for communication

Payment: $5 per thumbnail to start, via PayPal, paid once each thumbnail is approved. This will increase to up to $10 per thumbnail as your designs prove themselves with strong clicks and views.



Shortlisted designers will be asked to create one free sample thumbnail before we start working together.



If you’re interested in a long-term opportunity, reach out!



Thumbnail guidelines:



Maximum of three focus points

Bright, vibrant colours

Strong contrast so it stands out in the YouTube feed

A simple overall look, clean and uncluttered

Reflects the topic clearly at a glance



Message me with YOUR MOST RELEVANT PREVIOUS WORK, NOT YOUR ENTIRE PORTFOLIO.



Write the word “THUMBNAIL” in your message, otherwise you will be considered an outreach bot.



This is a serious long-term position. If our partnership works well, I will provide a lot of work.

title: CapCut & Canva Content Production Assistant (Part-Time, Long-Term) — 2ND ROUND NEW APPLICANTS ONLY
description:
SECOND ROUND OF RECRUITMENT: SHORTLISTED CANDIDATES FROM THE FIRST ROUND HAVE ALREADY BEEN CONTACTED. PLEASE DO NOT REAPPLY IF YOU HAVE ALREADY APPLIED - NEW APPLICANTS ONLY.



We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person for a long-term working relationship.



This is not a creative editing role. We provide the videos, text, templates, fonts, colors and instructions. The work is straightforward, but attention to detail, independent problem-solving and quality control are essential.



1. INITIAL RESPONSIBILITIES: CAPCUT REELS



1. Format supplied videos for 9:16 and make basic cuts when needed.

2. Generate English auto-captions and correct transcription mistakes.

3. Apply our existing caption templates, fonts, colors and branding.

4. Add supplied hooks, banners and on-screen text.

5. Create Reel thumbnails in Canva or CapCut using our templates.

6. Export finished videos and thumbnails, upload them to Google Drive and update Google Sheets.



Initial workload: at least 7 Reels per week, with the potential to grow.



2. FUTURE RESPONSIBILITIES: CANVA CONTENT



Once we're satisfied with the quality of your Reel production, we'll gradually add B-roll/text-overlay videos and carousel creation in Canva.



We provide all text, templates and instructions. You arrange the text, adjust line breaks and spacing, and ensure the final result looks clean, readable and visually appealing.



3. WHAT MATTERS MOST



We need someone who follows instructions carefully, checks their own work, notices obvious problems and solves simple issues independently.



You must catch caption errors, audio/video sync problems, incorrect fonts or colors, visible placeholders, misplaced text and anything that looks unfinished before submitting it.



We expect common sense and independent judgment, not mechanical instruction-following. If a font is missing or something doesn't work as expected, investigate how to solve the problem rather than ignoring it.



Advanced editing skills are not required. Attention to detail, good English comprehension and reliability are much more important.



4. WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



1. Long-term, remote, part-time role.

2. Initial workload: at least 7 Reels per week.

3. Expected production time: approximately 2–4 hours per week initially, once trained, with the potential to increase as content volume and responsibilities grow. Actual hours will depend on the workload.

4. Turnaround: 24–48 hours per batch.

5. Rate: $4–5 USD per hour, depending on experience and performance.

6. Tools: CapCut, Canva, Google Drive, Google Sheets and WhatsApp.

7. Own computer and reliable internet required.



A small paid trial using our actual content and templates is required before ongoing work begins.



5. HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word CHECKED to show that you've read the post.



Please include your location, availability, CapCut/Canva experience, expected hourly rate, CV and your portfolio.



We're looking for someone who can work independently and consistently deliver finished content that is ready to use without repeated corrections for basic mistakes.

Please follow the application instructions below



About PropFix.ie



PropFix.ie is Ireland's trusted property maintenance specialist, offering comprehensive solutions with years of expertise across the construction and renovation sectors. We transform spaces through our diverse range of services, from handyman solutions and office fit-outs to complete renovations, house extensions, and specialized installations including doors, floors, and partitions.



Our commitment to delivering the best value property maintenance has established us as a reliable partner for residential and commercial clients nationwide. title: Meta Ads Specialist for an online membership: answer member questions + create step-by-step tutorials
description:
Hiii!



I’m Emelie Bernborg. I run The Webinar Room, an online membership for course creators and membership owners who use webinars to sell their offers. We have around 330 members across the world, and a lot of them run
 and Instagram ads to fill their webinars.



Inside the membership we have a thread just for ads questions. From November 1, I want an ads expert in that thread. That’s you, hopefully 🤍



Your part: the tech



I teach the messaging and the visuals myself: what to say in an ad, the hooks, the copy and how the ad should look. That’s my framework and it stays with me.



You handle everything technical: campaign setup, Ads Manager, audiences, budgets, pixel and tracking, reading the numbers, and account problems. If a member asks about their ad copy or creative, you pass it on to our team.



What you’ll do



❥ Answer members’ technical ads questions in our community thread, within two working days. Things like: why is my cost per lead going up, how should I set up my campaign, what budget should I start with, why isn’t my pixel tracking.

❥ Help members with the harder stuff too: a disabled ad account, rejected ads, a restricted Business Manager, a payment that suddenly stops working. You give clear first steps and simple guidance, so they know what to do next and don’t panic.

❥ Write your answers in a warm, personal and clear way. Our members are smart business owners, not ads people. Many of them are a bit scared of Ads Manager. They need to feel helped, not judged.

❥ Create short tutorials (“episodes”) for the membership, step by step, in image format: screenshots from Ads Manager with clear explanations of each step. For example: how to set up a lead campaign, how to install the pixel, how to read your results, how to turn off settings that hurt your ads.

❥ Pass on questions about copy and creative, and flag anything you’re unsure about to our team, so nobody gets a wrong answer.



Later on (not from day one)



Members who need more personal help with the technical side may be able to book you for paid 1:1 sessions. This is something we want to grow into together once you know the membership and the members know you.



You are a great fit if you



✔ Have hands-on experience running Meta ads 
 + Instagram) in both Europe and the US, and know the differences between them (rules, targeting options, costs)

✔ Ideally have run lead generation for webinars, courses or online programs

✔ Know Ads Manager inside out: campaign structure, audiences, budgets, pixel and events, reading the numbers

✔ Know how to handle account problems: disabled or restricted ad accounts, Business Manager restrictions, ad rejections, appeals and Meta’s ad policies

✔ Write excellent English, warm and easy to understand

✔ Can explain something technical so a beginner gets it on the first read

✔ Are reliable with deadlines (our members are promised an answer within two working days)

✔ Like people. Truly. This role is half ads, half care.

✔ Bonus, not a must: experience with YouTube, LinkedIn or Pinterest ads



The details



❥ Part-time, remote, around 2–4 hours per week to start, with room to grow as the membership grows

❥ Start: November 1

❥ Pay: hourly rate based on experience. Tell us your rate in your application.

❥ Tools: Meta Ads Manager, our community platform, Slack, Canva (for the step-by-step images)



How to apply



Please send:



A short intro about you and your ads experience

One or two examples of campaigns you’ve run, with results (cost per lead, ROAS or similar)

Your answer to this member question: “My ads were getting leads for $3 last week, now it’s $7 and nothing changed. What should I do?” Write it exactly as you would reply in our community.

And one more: “I woke up and my ad account is disabled. I have a webinar in five days. Help!” How would you answer her?



Start your application with the words “TWR ADS” so I know you read the whole post. 



Can’t wait to meet you!

/Emelie

Creator community & influencer support

- Share briefs and winning angles, review submitted videos and give clear, kind feedback

- Keep creators motivated through group chats, broadcasts, recognition and small rewards

- Support our influencer partnerships with coordination, follow-ups and tracking

Founder support & operations

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automations) to work faster and smarter



WHO YOU ARE

- You're hungry. You want more than a paycheck - you want to learn, grow, and build something.

- You take ownership. When you start something, you see it through

- A friendly, supportive team that always has your back

title: IN DEMAND: Experienced AI Video Editor (PHP 75.000/month + BONUS)
description:
Most editing jobs hand you footage and a deadline.



This one hands you a script. You create everything else.



We're a fast-growing DTC health & beauty brand.



We scale on Meta cold traffic, so the creative is the business. A winning ad pays for months. A loser dies in 48 hours.

We need someone who can build ads out of nothing but AI tools and taste.



Why work for us:



- You earn on every winner. Base salary plus a bonus on every ad that wins. Your ads get real budget. When they perform, you get paid for it. Month after month, as long as it runs.



- You'll get seriously good at this. You'll learn direct response creative from people spending real money every week. Hooks, pacing, angles, why a 3-second open d
 everything. You'll see the performance data on everything you make. Most editors never find out if their work worked. You will.



- You grow with the team. This is a core seat, not a gig. Salary reviewed at 3 months, then regularly. As we scale, this role becomes creative lead. First person in gets that shot.



- You work when you work best. Flexible hours. We measure output, not screen time. Some overlap with the team, the rest is yours.



- Every tool paid for. Higgsfield, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, the full stack. Covered.



- One brand. One direction. No five clients with five opinions. Clear briefs, direct feedback, fast decisions.



What you'll do



You get a script. You deliver a launch-ready ad.



- Build AI avatars in HeyGen that don't look like AI avatars



- Direct ElevenLabs voiceovers with real emotion — we'll teach you our system



- Generate b-roll, product motion and 3D sequences in Higgsfield



- Cut it: pacing, pattern interrupts, sound, captions

- You've edited real DTC ecommerce ads that ran as paid traffic. Not weddings. Not explainers.



- You use AI video tools daily. You need a brief, not a tutorial.



- You can do 3D or motion work — product animation, mechanism visuals, kinetic type.



- You're fast in Premiere, After Effects, CapCut Pro or DaVinci.



- You have taste. You know which cut holds attention.



- You take direct feedback well. "Recut the first 3 seconds" is normal here.



- Solid English. Reliable on deadlines



$1,200 – $1,800 USD/month depending on experience. Plus a performance bonus on every winning ad. Reviewed every month.

- 3–5 DTC ads you edited.



- Tell me which is the best one.



- Your AI tool stack. What you use, how often.



- One AI-generated video you've made. Any subject.

title: Brand Protection VA (Amazon Brand Registry, Shopify & DMCA Takedowns) — Part-Time
description:
We are a growing e-commerce supplement brand selling in the US through our own Shopify store and Amazon. Copycats have started imitating our brand — fake Shopify stores using our name, copied Amazon listings, stolen product photos — and we need one reliable person to find them and get them taken down, week after week.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Amazon: monitor for listings and sellers using our brand name or product images, and file "Report a Violation" reports through Amazon Brand Registry until they are removed

- Shopify: find copycat Shopify stores using our name, logo or images, and file Shopify's trademark/impersonation and DMCA reports until they are taken down

- Log every hit in our tracking sheet with full-page screenshots, URLs, seller/store names and dates before filing anything

- Follow up on every report until the listing or store is actually down, and re-file when it comes back

- Flag repeat offenders or cases the platform forms can't solve to us, so our attorney can step in

- Send a short weekly report: found, filed, removed, pending



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Hands-on experience filing Amazon Brand Registry violation reports (required)

- Experience with Shopify takedown reports — trademark, impersonation or DMCA (required)

- Clear written English; you'll be completing formal forms

- Organized and methodical; comfortable working from a checklist with little supervision

- Nice to have: Meta Ad Library, Google and TikTok IP reporting; WHOIS and Wayback Machine lookups



RULES OF THE ROLE

- You file platform reports only. You never contact infringers directly — no
s, no messages, no threats. Anything beyond platform reports goes to our attorney.

title: Video Editor for You Tube Golf niche
description:
I enjoy editing my YouTube videos in Adobe Premiere, but I need to streamline my workflow and editing is a bottleneck for me.   I’d like an experienced editor who already has a good workflow and communication system so we don’t have to reinvent the wheel in developing a video production schedule and efficient process.

1. I’d like to see a few samples of your work

2. If we seem like a good match, I’m willing to pay you a nominal fee for a test edit on my footage, I’ll upload it to a Google drive?

3. Do you use Premier?  Frame.io?  Photoshop? 

4. Can you use the object mask tool or rotoscope in Premier if needed?

5. Can you use generative fill in Premier or Photoshop if needed?

6. Can you adjust audio in Premier?  Or what do you use?  Sometimes wind noise or other noise needs to be reduced or dialogue needs to be enhanced.

8. Do you have access to licensed B-roll and background music?  Which service?  It’s not required.

9. How do you handle copyright claims?

10. Can you edit a variety of video formats…. Talking head, walking and talking, golfing on course, voice overs?

11. How would you describe your style of editing?

12. How many years have you been editing for clients and do you have references from them?   How many years have you been editing YOUR OWN videos?

13. How do you charge for your services?  Per video? Per hour? Per minute of finished video?  Per month for so many videos?   What’s your preference?

14. How would you describe your usage of AI tools in your edits?  Give me an example and your preferred AI tools and how you use them?

15. I only publish to YouTube…. No tik tok, No instagram, No
.  Simple 😊

16. I mainly do long form and occasional short form vertical format.  Are you ok with that.  My videos are normally 8 to 15 minutes, but occasionally over that and maybe closer to 30 minutes.   

17. Can you do Thumbnails?  Do you want to do and LIKE to do thumbnails?

18. I would retain ownership of all my footage and all the work product that you produce for me.   Is that ok with you?

19. Do you have a written agreement with your creators or don’t really think it’s necessary?

20. Is video editing your full time job or do you have another job?  And what do you do? Just curious.

21. What’s your favorite thing about editing videos?  or your LEAST favorite thing about editing videos?

22. Describe your favorite client, past or present, and why did you like working for them?

23.  If I made a million dollars on the videos that you edited, how much of that do you think I should pay to you?

24. If I lost a million dollars making videos that you edited, how much of that do you think you should pay back to me?

25. What questions do you have for me?  Or anything you want me to know about you?



I know that’s a lot of questions !!  I hope it puts us a few steps closer to working with each other or mutually deciding we’re just not a good match for each other.   Either way, I appreciate you taking the time to consider working with me.

Thanks

Joe

PS:  I entered $300/month for salary because the form required an amount.... If you prefer to charge per edited video, we can discuss a rate per video?

title: Long & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About the Role



We are a fast-growing wellness brand rethinking the traditional protein bar — an all-natural, whole-food protein bar using clean, recognizable ingredients. As the brand expands across retail, our founders are documenting the behind-the-scenes journey of building the business — from travelling across the US and supporting retail launches to demos, events, and everyday startup life.



We're looking for a Long & Short-Form Video Editor to turn that raw footage into engaging, story-driven content. This role will primarily focus on editing long-form YouTube-style content, supported by short-form edits for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and the founders' personal social channels.



You'll receive raw footage from the founders and be responsible for turning it into polished, engaging content that captures the personality, energy, and reality of building a fast-growing consumer brand. We're looking for someone who is more than a technical editor — you should understand storytelling, pacing, humour, hooks, and retention, and be able to identify the moments within hours of footage that are actually worth watching.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities



1. Long-Form Video Editing



Edit raw founder footage into engaging YouTube-style episodes, typically around 15–25 minutes

Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, storylines, and narrative arcs

Turn loosely structured footage into cohesive, entertaining stories

Cut unnecessary material while maintaining natural pacing and personality

Add music, sound effects, text, graphics, subtitles, and other elements where appropriate

Handle basic colour correction, audio cleanup, and overall visual consistency

Create strong openings and hooks that encourage viewers to continue watching

Incorporate B-roll and supporting footage to strengthen storytelling

Manage revisions and deliver polished final edits on schedule

2. Short-Form Content



Turn long-form footage and standalone clips into TikToks, Instagram Reels, and other vertical content

Identify short moments that can work independently as compelling social content

Edit clips with strong hooks, captions, pacing, and platform-native formatting

Create content for both the brand and the founders' personal accounts

Develop teasers and cutdowns that help drive audiences toward longer YouTube content

Repurpose existing footage efficiently to maximise the value of each shoot

3. Content & Editing Workflow



Organise raw footage, project files, and completed assets in a clear and repeatable system

Maintain consistent editing styles, fonts, graphics, and visual treatments

Work closely with the founders to understand their preferred style and continuously refine it

Manage multiple videos at different stages of the editing process

Proactively suggest opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content

Stay current with editing styles and content trends across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram

Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years of professional video editing experience

Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both long-form and short-form editing; experience editing YouTube, documentary-style, vlog, founder-led, or behind-the-scenes content

Storytelling: Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention; ability to take several hours of raw footage and independently determine what should make the final cut

Short-Form: Excellent short-form editing instincts for TikTok and Instagram Reels

Technical: Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software; comfortable with captions, motion graphics, sound design, and basic colour correction

Organisation: Highly organised and able to manage large volumes of footage

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; able to work independently with limited direction

Bonus: Experience editing content for CPG, food, wellness, fitness, or lifestyle brands; experience editing founder-led YouTube series or startup/build-in-public content; basic motion graphics or After Effects experience; YouTube thumbnail design; familiarity with YouTube retention analytics; experience repurposing long-form content into multiple short-form assets

title: Quality Assurance Team Lead (KYC/KYB Experience)
description:
Key Responsibilities

– Build and implement the KYC/KYB QA framework, including sampling, scoring and review methodology. Design the QA framework from the ground up, a risk-weighted sampling approach (higher-risk cases reviewed more frequently than lower-risk ones), a scoring methodology that captures both document completeness and the quality of the risk judgment behind it, and a review cadence that scales as case volume grows.

– Conduct quality reviews of KYC/KYB, CDD and EDD cases, including higher-risk customers. Independently review completed onboarding files checking risk-tier accuracy, screening disposition, source of funds/wealth evidencing, and (for entity clients) whether ownership structures were properly unwrapped to identify beneficial owners. Higher-risk and EDD cases receive closer scrutiny given the greater consequence of getting them wrong.

– Identify errors, trends and root causes and recommend improvements. Go beyond flagging individual mistakes — group findings by root cause (e.g. a documentation gap vs. a genuine risk judgment error vs. a partner-specific requirement being missed) so fixes target the actual cause, whether that's a training gap, an SOP gap, or a partner requirement that isn't properly documented.

– Develop QA reporting, KPIs and management information for the Head of Compliance.

– Own a regular reporting cadence covering quality trends, recurring error types, and partner specific RFI patterns — feeding a core KPI: reducing avoidable back-and-forth with our banking partners by catching issues before submission, not after.

– Work closely with the Head of Compliance to improve processes and controls.

– Act as the operational link between the compliance policy framework and how the team actually executes day to day — flagging where documented process and real practice have drifted apart, and helping close that gap.

– Identify training needs and provide feedback to onboarding teams.

– Use QA findings to drive what training actually happens — not generic refreshers, but targeted sessions addressing the specific gaps the data is showing (e.g. a pattern of source of funds vs. source of wealth confusion, or inconsistent handling of layered ownership structures).

– Continuously improve the QA framework as the business grows.

– Evolve the framework as new banking partners, products, or entity types are added.



Qualifications

– Must have at least 3 years of QA KYC team lead experience

– Must have experience in KYC, AML, Compliance or Financial Crime QA within fintech, payments or financial services.

– Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and risk-based onboarding.

– Direct, hands-on experience assessing KYC/KYB case quality (not general customer support QA experience). This role needs someone who can independently judge whether a compliance decision was right, not just whether a process step was followed.

– Experience building a QA framework from scratch. (This is a build role, not a maintain role. The successful candidate has built up a QA function before, not just operated within an existing one

– Strong understanding of QA methodologies, scorecard design, and performance evaluation.

– Comfortable designing scoring criteria that are consistent and defensible across reviewers, and calibrating so different reviewers reach the same conclusion on the same file.

– Genuine technical depth, able to independently assess whether a risk tier was applied correctly, whether EDD was sufficient, and whether an ownership structure was properly unwrapped, not just whether a checklist was completed.

– Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Able to turn QA findings into practical process improvements/training

– QA findings are only useful if they change something, this role needs to turn patterns into concrete process, training, or policy recommendations, not just produce reports.

– Confident, challenging decisions and escalating issues. This role will sometimes need to tell an experienced analyst, or flag to the Head of Compliance, that something isn't good enough.

– The end output of QA work here isn't a report that sits unread — it's a training session, an SOP update, or a process fix that actually closes the gap that was found.

– Must be comfortable using their own equipment

– Must be comfortable working Dubai hours

– Must be able to commit to working exclusively with the company and not be engaged in any part-time employment

– If you’ve read carefully the entire job description, please message us your updated CV with “QA Team Lead with KYC Experience” as the message subject

title: Growth Web Developer (SEO, AI Search & Conversion)
description:
ABOUT US

The National Pharmacy Technician Association (NPTA) is the largest professional organization for pharmacy technicians in the U.S. We run several websites and online programs: training, certification prep, continuing education, and membership. - 3+ years building websites, with a portfolio that includes landing pages or e-commerce/checkout work

- Hands-on technical SEO experience. Be ready to show rankings or traffic you've improved

- Familiarity with CRO principles and tools such as heatmaps, session recordings, and A/B testing

- Awareness of how AI search engines source and cite content, or real curiosity about learning it fast

- Comfort with GA4 and Google Tag Manager

- Clear written English and the habit of explaining WHY you made a change, not just what you changed

- Experience with membership sites, LMS platforms (LearnDash a plus), or WooCommerce is a strong plus



WORK SETUP & PAY

- Part-time contract to start (about 20 hours/week), moving to full-time

- You must be available to work full-time hours (40/week) when the role expands, so please only apply if you can commit to that

Send your portfolio and one example of a page you improved, with the before-and-after result (traffic, rankings, or conversion rate). Start your application with the phrase "Pages that convert" so we know you read the whole post.

Investors Sales Profile: High-Ticket Outbound Prospecting & Setting



Remuneration: Competitive Base Rate + Uncapped



High-Ticket Bonuses Employment Type: Full-Time Permanent



1. Role Overview



We are looking for an ambitious, highly resilient, and persuasive High-Ticket Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter to join our team. In this role, you will be making outbound calls to a database of over 1,000 UK-based property investors. Your primary objective is to engage high-net-worth investors, qualify their capital capacity and investment goals, build rapid rapport, and book high-quality appointments onto our Senior Director’s calendar for our premium, high-ticket 'Done-For-You' Turnkey Property Investment Service. Because this involves high-ticket investment offerings, you must excel in professional communication, executive-level rapport building, and articulate value-driven conversations. If you thrive in high-volume cold calling, possess an exceptional command of spoken English, and know how to navigate high-ticket objections smoothly, this role offers exceptional earning potential, stability, and ongoing support.



2. Key Responsibilities



· High-Volume Outbound Prospecting: Execute 100+ outbound calls daily to a database of UK property investors using our CRM and auto-dialer setup.



· High-Ticket Qualification & Booking: Qualify leads against strict investor criteria (liquid capital, readiness, and fit) and secure confirmed high-ticket sales appointments directly onto the Senior Director's calendar.



· Attendance & Show-Up Management: Manage pre-call nurture sequences via SMS, Email, and WhatsApp to ensure maximum attendance rates and follow up rigorously with any missed appointments.



· Executive Objection Handling: Confidently navigate gatekeepers, brush-offs, and high-ticket investor objections (e.g., market timing, capital deployment, trust) using proven conversational frameworks.



· CRM & Data Maintenance: Accurately log call notes, investor profiles, dispositions, follow-up dates, and lead statuses in our CRM immediately after every interaction.

title: Funnel Tech Lead (GoHighLevel + Meta Ads), remote
description:
Client: A Danish psychotherapy practice moving its group programme online. Name shared with shortlisted candidates.

Type: Freelance contract. Three month trial, with the aim of a long term collaboration.

Language: Written English. The copy you build is in Danish, and you don't need to read it.



ABOUT THE PROJECT



The practice is run by a certified psychotherapist with over twenty years of experience. She runs group programmes that help people with the patterns that keep getting in the way of their relationships.



We are taking her programme online with an application funnel:

Meta ads ‚Üí webinar registration ‚Üí live webinar ‚Üí application ‚Üí one to one call with the founder ‚Üí purchase



Morten Hake leads the strategy and writes the copy. You own everything technical: you build it, launch it, run the ads and keep it working. Later we add social media and SEO.



This is not a fixed list of pages. We test, we learn, and when a new idea makes sense, it gets built. The work grows with the business.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Build in GoHighLevel

- Landing pages, registration and thank you pages, recording page, application page and form, sales page, purchase confirmation

-
 sequences, workflows and automations, pipelines, calendar booking for the founder's calls

- Webinar registration and reminders, connected to Zoom Webinar

- Text message reminders through a provider that delivers well in Denmark (CM.com, ClickSend or similar)



Payments

- Stripe, Klarna, Vipps/MobilePay, and part payment plans, connected to the right confirmation
s



Meta Ads

- Setting up and running campaigns inside the client's own Business Manager

- Pixel and Conversions API, with a separate event for qualified applications

- Uploading creatives, testing, reading the numbers and reporting what works



Setup and growth

- Domain, DNS and
 authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)

- Google Search Console and the basics of SEO

- Editing short vertical videos and scheduling posts



HOW YOU WORK



- You use AI every day. Claude Code, Codex or similar, to build pages and sections faster and better than the standard GoHighLevel editor allows.

- You think for yourself. You get a brief, you understand what it's for, and you find the best way to build it. If something won't work as written, you say so before you build it, and suggest what will.

- Your deadlines hold. When we agree a date, it's done by that date. If something threatens it, we hear it from you before the date, not after.

- You test before anything goes live. The whole journey, on mobile, as a real lead would experience it.

- Close at first, then on your own. In the first weeks we work closely together while you get to know the project. After that you run it yourself, with a short update at the end of each working day: what's done, what's next, what you're waiting for.



WHAT MATTERS MOST



We weigh mindset and effort above everything else. Anything technical can be learned, and you will get mentoring along the way. If we work well together and the attitude is right, it doesn't matter that you can't tick every box below. Apply anyway.



Must have

- Hands on experience building funnels in GoHighLevel

- Experience running Meta Ads

- You use AI tools in your daily work

- Clear, reliable written English

- You work alone, not as a team behind one name. The person we talk to is the person who does the work.



Good to have, or willing to learn quickly

- Payment setups: Stripe, Klarna, Vipps/MobilePay, part payment

- Text message providers for Denmark

- Zoom Webinar integration

- DNS and
 deliverability

- Google Search Console and SEO

- Short video editing (CapCut, Premiere or similar)



ACCOUNTS AND ACCESS



- Every account is created in the practice's name and owned by the founder.

- You get the access each task needs. Admin access only where a task requires it.

- Two factor authentication on every account.

- Logins are never shared, and no one else works on the practice's accounts without written approval. That includes assistants and subcontractors.

- Personal data is handled according to GDPR and stays inside the practice's own systems.

- Everything you build belongs to the practice.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word Holder, so we know you read this far. Then send:

1. Links to two or three funnels you have built in GoHighLevel, and what you built in each

2. Results from Meta campaigns you have run, if you can share them

3. A short screen recording (3 to 5 minutes) walking through something you built, and how you used AI to build it

4. Your hourly rate, how many hours a week you can give this, and your time zone

5. Your full name, your company name if you have one, and the country you invoice from. These must match the contract and the bank details.



THE TEST

Shortlisted candidates do a small paid test: a registration page with checkout in GoHighLevel, and a Meta campaign set up to drive traffic to it. We decide after the test.

title: 🚨 NOW HIRING: EXPERIENCED CREDIT REPAIR DISPUTE SPECIALIST VA
description:
Remote Position | Long-Term Opportunity | Experienced Professionals ONLY



We are looking for a highly experienced, results-driven Credit Repair Dispute Specialist Virtual Assistant to join our growing team long-term.



⚠️ IMPORTANT: WE ARE ONLY LOOKING FOR EXPERIENCED DISPUTERS WHO HAVE PROVEN KNOWLEDGE OF ADVANCED DISPUTE STRATEGIES, EXPEDITED TECHNIQUES, AND A TRACK RECORD OF PRODUCING FAST RESULTS.



We are NOT looking for beginners or individuals who only know how to generate basic dispute letters and wait 30–45 days for responses.



We want someone who understands advanced credit repair, knows multiple legitimate dispute methods, and has hands-on experience obtaining expedited deletions and corrections.



🔥 FAST DELETIONS & ADVANCED DISPUTING EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



You must have experience disputing and successfully resolving inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unverifiable information involving:



* Collections

* Charge-offs

* Bankruptcies

* Repossessions

* Foreclosures

* Late payments

* Student loans

* Medical collections

* Hard inquiries

* Judgments and public records

* Closed derogatory accounts

* Other negative credit reporting items



WE ARE ESPECIALLY INTERESTED IN SPECIALISTS WHO HAVE ACHIEVED LEGITIMATE DELETIONS WITHIN 7–30 DAYS.



You should understand how to identify opportunities for expedited results, use appropriate escalation methods, analyze reporting inconsistencies, and develop strategies beyond standard dispute letters.



We understand that not every negative account qualifies for removal and that results cannot be guaranteed. However, we expect applicants to have proven experience identifying legitimate opportunities to obtain faster results.



If you only know how to send generic dispute letters, this position is NOT for you.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Review and analyze complete 3-bureau credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

* Identify inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, inconsistent, or unverifiable reporting.

* Develop customized dispute strategies based on each client’s credit profile.

* Utilize advanced, legally compliant dispute techniques and expedited escalation procedures when appropriate.

* Prepare and submit disputes to credit bureaus and furnishers.

* Handle complicated collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, repossessions, and other derogatory accounts.

* Identify reporting violations, inconsistencies, and legitimate opportunities for faster resolutions.

* Manage multiple clients and dispute rounds simultaneously.

* Track dispute deadlines, bureau responses, deletions, updates, and investigation results.

* Review all results before determining the next dispute strategy.

* Escalate complicated files and unresolved reporting issues when necessary.

* Maintain detailed client notes, dispute histories, and documentation.

* Upload dispute letters, results, and supporting documents into DisputeFox.

* Communicate regularly with customer service, management, and other departments through Slack.

* Use GoHighLevel to manage client information, tasks, pipeline stages, follow-ups, and workflows.

* Properly complete client and task handoffs between departments.

* Keep DisputeFox, Slack, and GoHighLevel updated so the entire team knows where each client stands.

* Follow company SOPs, compliance procedures, and confidentiality requirements.



ADVANCED DISPUTE EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We strongly prefer applicants with hands-on experience in the following areas:



Credit Repair & Dispute Strategies



* Traditional bureau disputes

* Direct furnisher disputes

* Advanced credit report analysis

* FCRA Sections 609, 611, and 623

* FCRA Section 605B for legitimate identity-theft cases

* Metro 2 reporting accuracy analysis

* Method-of-verification requests

* Reinsertion disputes

* CFPB complaints and escalations

* BBB complaints

* FTC identity-theft reports when legitimately applicable

* LexisNexis disputes

* ChexSystems disputes

* Early Warning Services disputes

* Complex bankruptcy disputes

* Collection and charge-off reporting disputes

* Repossession reporting disputes

* Expedited resolution opportunities

* Advanced escalation procedures

* Investigation of inaccurate furnisher reporting



Software & Team Management



* DisputeFox

* Slack

* GoHighLevel (GHL)

* LetterStream

* Credit monitoring and 3-bureau report analysis platforms

* CRM management

* Client pipeline management

* Workflow automation

* Task assignments and departmental handoffs

* Dispute tracking and reporting



We are looking for someone who understands WHY a dispute strategy works, WHEN to use it, and HOW to execute it effectively.



The more advanced legitimate credit repair techniques, systems, and strategies you bring to the table, the better.



REQUIREMENTS



* Previous professional credit repair/disputing experience is required.

* Proven experience handling collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, and other complicated derogatory accounts.

* Strong understanding of advanced dispute methods and expedited resolution opportunities.

* Demonstrated history of obtaining legitimate deletions and corrections.

* Ability to explain previous dispute strategies and results.

* DisputeFox experience is a BIG PLUS.

* Experience working with Slack and GoHighLevel is strongly preferred.

* Ability to manage a high volume of active client files.

* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Strong written English and professional communication.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple dispute rounds.

* Ability to communicate effectively with multiple departments.

* Comfortable following SOPs, workflows, and compliance requirements.

* Ability to maintain accurate documentation and client records.

* Strict confidentiality when handling sensitive client information.

* Dependable, accountable, and committed to long-term growth.



⚠️ WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



Please DO NOT apply if:



* You are a beginner with little or no credit repair experience.

* You only know how to generate basic dispute letters.

* You have no experience with advanced dispute strategies.

* You cannot explain your expedited dispute techniques.

* You have never successfully handled complicated derogatory accounts.

* You cannot demonstrate or explain previous results.

* You struggle with managing multiple clients and deadlines.

* You are unfamiliar with organized remote team communication.

* You do not consistently update client files and CRM systems.

* You are looking for a temporary position instead of long-term employment.

* You rely on fabricated identity-theft claims, false documentation, or unlawful dispute practices.



WE NEED SOMEONE WHO CAN BRING EXPERIENCE, ADVANCED KNOWLEDGE, AND REAL VALUE TO OUR TEAM FROM DAY ONE.



LONG-TERM CAREER OPPORTUNITY



We are building a professional, organized, high-performing credit repair team.



We are not looking for someone who only wants a temporary job. We want individuals who are dependable, motivated, team-oriented, and committed to growing with us.



We value employees who take initiative, solve problems, communicate effectively, and consistently produce quality work.



Strong performers will have opportunities to move into leadership positions, take on additional responsibilities, and grow within the company.



📩 HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and answer ALL of the following questions.



1. How many years of professional credit repair experience do you have?

2. What credit repair software and CRM platforms have you used?

3. Have you used DisputeFox? If yes, for how long?

4. Have you used Slack to manage daily tasks and communicate with a remote team?

5. Have you used GoHighLevel? What features, workflows, and automations have you worked with?

6. How many active client files can you comfortably manage at one time?

7. List ALL traditional, advanced, and expedited dispute methods you have hands-on experience using.

8. What expedited dispute techniques have you successfully used to achieve faster deletions or corrections?

9. Do you have experience obtaining deletions or corrections involving collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, repossessions, and late payments? Explain your experience.

10. What is the fastest legitimate deletion or correction you have achieved? How many days did it take, and what strategy did you use?

11. Have you successfully achieved documented deletions or corrections within 7–30 days? If yes, explain the types of accounts and methods used.

12. Do you have experience with CFPB complaints, BBB complaints, FTC identity-theft disputes, LexisNexis, ChexSystems, Early Warning Services, and LetterStream?

13. Do you understand Metro 2 reporting standards, FCRA dispute requirements, and how to identify credit reporting inaccuracies?

14. Briefly explain how you analyze a new client’s 3-bureau credit report and determine the most effective dispute strategy.

15. What is your next step when traditional dispute rounds fail to produce results?

16. Have you worked in a system where customer service, dispute specialists, and management hand clients and tasks off between departments?

17. Can you provide redacted examples, case studies, or documented proof of previous successful deletions and expedited results? Do not share sensitive client information.

18. What additional advanced credit repair knowledge, techniques, or skills can you bring to our team?

19. What is your expected hourly rate?

20. How many hours per week are you available, and when can you start?



🚨 IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE EXACT WORDS:



“EXPERIENCED DISPUTER VA”



This lets us know you have read the entire job posting and can follow instructions.



Applications that do not answer all required questions may not be considered.



PRIORITY WILL BE GIVEN TO APPLICANTS WHO HAVE:



✅ Extensive advanced credit repair experience.



✅ Proven knowledge of expedited dispute strategies.



✅ Experience achieving legitimate deletions and corrections within 7–30 days.



✅ Strong experience handling collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, and repossessions.



✅ Knowledge of CFPB escalations, Metro 2 reporting, and FCRA dispute procedures.



✅ Experience with DisputeFox, Slack, and GoHighLevel.



✅ Ability to manage high-volume client files efficiently.



✅ Documented examples of successful results.



✅ Strong communication, organization, and teamwork skills.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR BASIC LETTER GENERATORS. WE ARE LOOKING FOR EXPERIENCED DISPUTE SPECIALISTS WHO UNDERSTAND ADVANCED STRATEGIES, KNOW HOW TO PURSUE EXPEDITED RESULTS LEGALLY, AND CAN HELP OUR TEAM OPERATE AT A HIGH LEVEL.



SERIOUS, EXPERIENCED APPLICANTS ONLY.

description:

Ability to follow and capitalize on emerging trends, creating unique and compelling video content.

A strong desire to be creative and push the limits with new video concepts for our advertising campaigns.

You need to be a self-starter. You will be given the creative freedom to create winning assets and data from the brands you work on.





Overview:

As part of the ACTIV agency, you play a crucial role in shaping the visual storytelling and narrative of our ecommerce clients. Your expertise in video editing will be instrumental in creating compelling content that not only reflects the essence of each brand but also drives new customer acquisition at scale. Given the remote nature of your role, we value independence, communication, and the ability to manage time effectively across different time zones.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Video Editing: You will be responsible for editing raw footage into polished content for Meta & TikTok. This involves cutting hooks effectively, creating a cohesive story through the video content, and making the video engaging and effective to drive higher thumb stop rates (staying past the first 3 seconds), longer hold times (watching for at least 15 seconds), and high click through rates.



Collaboration: Regularly collaborate with the creative team, including directors, content creators, and other editors, to align on the creative vision and ensure that the final products meet or exceed client expectations. Communication will primarily be via digital platforms, including Slack, and once a week video calls via Slack.

Creative Input: Contribute ideas and suggestions to improve content quality during brainstorming sessions and creative meetings. Your input on the creative direction, storytelling elements, and visual style is highly valued.

Project Management: Manage your video editing projects from conception to delivery, ensuring that all content is completed within the agreed timelines and adheres to the client's brand guidelines. This includes prioritizing tasks, setting milestones, and keeping stakeholders informed of progress.

Quality Control: Ensure all videos meet ACTIV’s quality standards and are optimized for viewing on Meta & TikTok.

Technical Proficiency: Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of video editing software and technologies, suggesting upgrades or new tools as necessary to keep our content cutting-edge. ACTIV can and will provide you with additional software access when needed and necessary to do your job better.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Given your remote location and the flexible working hours, adaptability to the needs of the team and projects across time zones is essential. You must be willing to adjust your working hours when needed to meet critical deadlines or collaborate with the team.



Working Hours:

This position offers flexible working hours to accommodate the difference in time zones between Eastern Standard Time (New York, USA) and your time zone. We expect a reasonable overlap with the team's working hours for meetings and collaborative sessions but will work together to establish a schedule that suits everyone.



Expectations:

Maintain open and consistent communication with your team and direct report.

Deliver high-quality video content within specified deadlines.

Be proactive in addressing challenges or delays that may impact project timelines.



Tools and Software:

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, and other relevant video editing software is expected.



Compensation:

The Video Editor role is a dynamic position with the opportunity to significantly impact the success of our e-commerce clients through compelling video content. Recognizing the importance of this role, we offer competitive compensation packages for a full time role:

Compensation: 

Compensation is dependent on location of hire and competitive pay for the region the video editor is in. You will be asked your expected range of pay in your job application.

Note: Though output will be measured and managed, quality is essential. This is why we created a bonus structure that supports higher quality content that can scale spend behind it, versus creating a lot of content that may not scale spend behind it.



Expectations and Growth:

This role will be a full time role with expectations that we will provide you with the resources to succeed. This growth path is supported by a clear compensation and bonus structure that rewards high performance and the achievement of key milestones in ad spend supported by the content produced.We believe this structure will motivate our Video Editor to continuously strive for excellence, producing content that not only captivates audiences but also significantly contributes to the success of our e-commerce clients' campaigns.



To Apply:

To apply for this role, you will need to fill out this form: 
  that is 27 questions in total. You will then be asked to do a short project that displays your work with a loose brief and video resources provided showing your ability to take a brief and create a strong video creative from it. Once we review your video, we will set up an interview to the qualified candidates and then if you meet our standards then we would make a job offer.
