title: Live Online Strength Trainer – 2 one-hour video sessions/week, $5–7/hr
description:
I'm a 57-year-old woman in Boulder, Colorado, USA. I work out at home with dumbbells and elastic resistance bands, and I'm looking for a friendly personal trainer who speaks English to coach me live over video. We'd do 1-hour strength sessions twice a week, long-term. On some days I'm also open to Zumba-style cardio dance, if that's something you can teach.



Schedule: weekdays or weekends, with sessions starting between 7 and 9 am Denver time. We'll pick 2 days together.

- Philippines: 9–11 pm now, and 10 pm–midnight from Nov 1. A great fixed evening side job.

- India: 6:30–8:30 pm now, and 7:30–9:30 pm from Nov 1.

- Mexico City: 7–9 am now, and 8–10 am from Nov 1.



Pay: $5–7 USD an hour, depending on your experience and English skills. I pay weekly through the platform or by Wise or PayPal.



Grow your client base: if you do a great job, I'll gladly refer you to other Americans looking for online training.



You will: design progressive strength workouts for home training with dumbbells and bands, using AI tools like ChatGPT and YouTube demos to plan and share them. You'll lead each session live, watch and correct my form on camera, and track my progress.



Requirements: good spoken English, a stable internet connection with a webcam, and reliable attendance.



To apply, please answer:

1. How long have you been training people, and what kind of clients have you worked with?

2. Share a sample 1-week plan with 2 home sessions using dumbbells and bands that you made with help from AI, including YouTube links.

3. Can you lead Zumba-style cardio dance? (Optional.)

4. Which 2 days and start times, in your local time, can you commit to?



Next step: a paid 1-hour trial session at your rate.

title: GOHIGHLEVEL BUILDER & POSSIBLE FUTURE MANAGER (Multiple Openings)
description:
I run marketing systems on GoHighLevel. I write the specs. What I need are the people who build them - accurately, cleanly, and without needing to be chased.



This is not an architect role and it is not a client-facing role to start. You will be handed a clear spec and you will build it.



I am hiring multiple people for this position. Beyond just building, there is a clear upward path: the builder who proves the best understanding of the platform and demonstrates strong communication and people skills will step into a possible future manager position. As the manager, you will transition from hourly pay to a steady salary.



Every build gets reviewed by your future GM (who will handle onboarding, client communication, and team management) before it ships. You will get direct feedback and you will get better at this. If you want to build inside GoHighLevel all day with someone experienced checking your work, and want a shot at leading the team, this is a good seat.



==============================

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

SNAPSHOTS & WORKFLOWS



Sub-account snapshots from my template - pipelines, custom values, calendars, the full shell



Automation workflows to spec: multi-step, with wait steps, conditions, and goal events



Trigger links, opportunity stage automation, appointment reminders



FUNNELS, SITES & FORMS



Funnels, landing pages, order forms, surveys, calendars



Built from my wireframes and copy - clean, mobile-checked, reusable



DAY-TO-DAY BUILD WORK



Cloning and customizing snapshots across sub-accounts



Wiring up the integrations I hand you:

 lead ads, website forms, call tracking



Migrating and cleaning contacts - dedupe, tag by source



Running the full end-to-end test before you hand anything in: submit a test lead, confirm the text-back fires to a real phone, confirm the
 lands in the inbox and not spam, confirm the calendar books. Screenshot each step.



A short Loom on what you built and anything you were unsure about



NICE TO HAVE (not required)



Zapier or Make experience using existing recipes



GoHighLevel's built-in Conversation AI, set up following my prompts



I am NOT asking for custom code, API development, or AI agent design. I handle that side.



==============================

YOU MUST HAVE

Real hands-on time inside GoHighLevel - sub-accounts, workflows, calendars, pipelines. Not "I've watched the tutorials."



The ability to open a broken workflow and explain why it isn't firing



Genuine attention to detail - you follow the SOP exactly, and you tell me when the SOP is wrong



Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and comfort with time tracking (Timeproof)



At least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Central time



==============================

HOW I WORK

Project-based to start. I hand you a spec, you build it, your future GM reviews it, you ship. Clear scopes. No scope creep.



There is a ladder:



BUILDS 1-3 - Initial trial builds and rate review based on proven delivery.

ONGOING - Steady build volume and first pick of the work.

THE MANAGEMENT SEAT - The top builder with the best platform mastery and strong people/communication skills steps up into a full-time management position on a salary instead of hourly pay.



I am hiring multiple people. The ones who prove out get the volume; the standout leader gets the management seat.



==============================

WHAT I PAY

$5-$10/hour to start, based on what you can actually build.

Rate reviewed after every 3 completed builds.

Management position: Full-time salary (transitioning off hourly pay).



The rate moves with your accuracy. The less your reviewer has to correct, the faster you climb.



==============================

DO NOT APPLY IF

Your GoHighLevel experience is "I watched the tutorials"



You cannot explain what a custom value is and why it matters



You need to be reminded to test your own build



You are juggling 4 agencies and this would be filler work



You go quiet for days without sending a message



I would rather see 5 real applications than 300 copy-paste ones.



==============================

HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with: BUILD-[the name of one real GHL workflow trigger you have actually used]



Example format: BUILD-CustomerBookedAppointment

Applications without this are deleted unread.



In 4 sentences or fewer, tell me the most complex thing you have built inside GoHighLevel - and what broke while you were building it.



Link one Loom (3 minutes max) walking me through any real build you have done in GoHighLevel - even a simple one. Screen share the actual account. Tell me why you built it that way. I am not judging your video quality. I am judging whether you understand what you built.



No cover letters. No portfolios of logos. No "I am hardworking and fast learner." Show me the work.

title: Appointment Setter (Australian M&A Firm) | Part-Time, Mornings PH Time

WHAT YOU WILL DO



Respond quickly to replies from our outreach campaigns and turn them into calls

Prequalify business owners against each buyer’s criteria

Book qualified owners into our founder’s calendar and make sure they show

Follow up no-shows and stalled leads with a clear reason to reconnect

Log every conversation in our CRM (GoHighLevel) the same day

YOU MUST HAVE



At least 12 months of appointment setting, SDR, inside sales or telesales experience against booking or sales targets

Your actual numbers: what you were measured on and what you hit

Experience in a business where the scripts and process were still being built

Confident, clear spoken English on the phone

A fast learner who wants to hit the ground running and is keen to get on the phones from week one

Stable fibre or wired internet, plus backup internet and power

HOURS AND PAY



Monday to Friday, 7:00am to 10:00am Philippine time

Flat rate to start

Commission opportunity once you prove yourself, with a path into setting sales leads



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF



Your background is admin, VA or customer service with no booking or sales target

You need a full script for every situation before you pick up the phone

You prefer messaging to calling



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here:

title: Digital Product Designer + AI Creative Assistant
description:
🎉 WE'RE HIRING! Creative Canva Designer + AI Design Specialist



Love designing? Obsessed with beautiful fonts, fun color palettes, and creating products people actually want to buy? We might have the perfect opportunity for you!



We're a growing digital product brand, and we're looking for a seriously talented designer to join our little team!



We create all kinds of fun, creative digital products, from invitations and party printables to templates and other designs that we sell online. And we have SO many ideas for where we want to take this brand next!



That's where you come in!



We're looking for someone who genuinely LOVES design. Someone who gets excited about a beautiful layout, notices the little details, keeps up with what's trending, and can take an idea and turn it into something really, really good.



One thing to know: This isn't an entry-level Canva position.



We're looking for someone who's already very comfortable in Canva, has a great eye for design, and knows how to use AI image-generation tools to create beautiful, professional visuals.



You should be able to look at a reference product or trending design, understand what makes it appealing, and create something original that captures that same customer need and overall feel.



And while we'll absolutely provide direction and inspiration, we would LOVE someone who brings their own creativity and ideas to the table, too!



✨ YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:



• You're basically a Canva pro and can design quickly without sacrificing quality.

• You know your way around AI image-generation tools and can create beautiful, realistic, professional graphics.

• You have a REALLY good eye for typography, colors, layouts, and all those little details that make a design stand out.

• You love keeping up with design trends and figuring out what's selling.

• You can take inspiration and turn it into something original and polished.

• You enjoy creating product mockups and beautiful Etsy listing graphics.

• You're the type of person who will spend an extra few minutes adjusting something because you KNOW it could look better.

• You're organized, dependable, and can work independently without needing someone to walk you through every little step.

• You actually enjoy being creative and trying new things!



Bonus points if you've designed invitations, party printables, Etsy products, digital downloads, or anything similar!



💗 WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING WITH US



We're a small, growing business with BIG plans, and we're really excited to find someone who wants to be part of what we're building.



This isn't a position where you'll be stuck creating the exact same boring thing every single day.



One day you might be designing a whimsical birthday invitation, the next you're creating a new collection of party printables, experimenting with AI-generated artwork, or helping bring an entirely new product idea to life.



We love creativity, we love trying new things, and we genuinely want someone who enjoys that process as much as we do!



We're also big believers in giving talented people room to do what they're good at. We'll provide direction, references, and feedback, but we don't want to micromanage every little detail.



We want someone who can bring their own ideas, take ownership of their designs, and feel proud of what they're creating.



🌷 A LITTLE ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



This will start as a part-time position, but we're really hoping to find someone we can work with for a LONG time!



As the brand grows, there's absolutely potential for more hours, more responsibility, and a much bigger role within the business.



Our goal isn't just to hire someone to knock out a few designs. We'd love to find someone who becomes an important part of our creative team and helps us build something amazing.



💌 HOW TO APPLY



We'd love to see what you can do!



Please include the following in your application:



1. Complete our design challenge:





2. Your Canva/design portfolio or a few examples of your BEST work.



3. Examples of AI-generated images or designs you've created.



4. The AI image-generation tools you're currently comfortable using.



One little thing! To make sure you've read the entire posting, please include the word CONFETTI somewhere in your application. 🎉



Applicants who seem like a great fit will be invited to complete a short paid test project before we make our final decision

title: •   • Urgent: Virtual Assistant for Cleaning Company (Operations & Invoicing)
description:

I am currently overwhelmed and need a "hands-free" solution where you manage the tasks entirely.



Key Responsibilities (Your Daily Tasks):



1. Invoices & Bank Verification (High Priority):

* Create and send client invoices through QuickBooks.

* Monitor my bank accounts directly to verify when payments enter.

* Follow up automatically and persistently with clients who have overdue balances.



2. Calendar Clean-Up & Management:

* Review my Google Calendar, identify duplicate clients, and completely clean up the current scheduling mess.

* Map out new client requests, verify their physical addresses, calculate driving time, and place them in the correct open spots without double-booking.



3. Document Organization & Contract Renewals:

* Audit and organize all client files currently saved in Google Docs and Excel.

* Identify which commercial and residential clients need their contracts renewed, prepare the renewal documents, and follow up with them to secure the signatures.



4. Business Compliance & Insurance Tracking (New Priority):

* Track, manage, and complete annual business report filings and local permit/business tax receipt renewals on time to keep the business compliant.

* Manage insurance documentation, ensure our General Liability policy remains up to date, and send Certificates of Insurance (COI) to commercial clients upon request.



5. Quality Checks & Review Requests (Useful Duty):

* Follow up with clients via text or
 after a service is completed to check on quality.

* Send review links to happy clients to build up our Google Business Profile rating.



Growth & Hours Expansion Plan:

* We are starting with 4 hours a day. 

* As you help us bring in new leads, get more calls, and the business grows, your commitment will increase to 6 hours a day, with the ultimate goal of transitioning into a Full-Time position. Your pay will grow as the company grows.



Requirements:

* Must have hands-on experience working with a US-based cleaning company before. (Do not apply if you haven't managed cleaning routes/invoices.

* Full proficiency in QuickBooks Online, Google Calendar, Excel, and Google Docs.

* Excellent English (written and spoken). Being bilingual (Spanish/English) is a huge plus.

* Ability to work independently with zero supervision.



Salary & Hours:

* Rate: $4.00 to $5.00 USD per hour (depending on experience).

* Initial Hours: 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday (Part-Time to start).

title: Neon Sign Designer
description:
Role: Neon Sign Designer — Design Mockups & Production Files



Location: Remote — Filipino contractor

Hours: Full-time — Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm AEST

Rate: From $10 AUD/hr on a contractor basis



⚠ CorelDRAW proficiency is non-negotiable. This is a specialist role requiring genuine understanding of neon signage design and the manufacturing process — tube types, sizing specs, production file standards and CNC/laser cutting requirements. Applications without a portfolio of neon sign mockups and production files will not be considered.





About the Role

We are looking for a specialist Neon Sign Designer who genuinely understands the design and manufacturing process — not just graphic design.

This is a full-time role, Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm AEST. You'll be working directly with the team to produce high-quality neon sign designs from brief through to production-ready output. You need to understand how neon signs are actually made — the materials, the tube specifications, the tolerances and what makes a file manufacturer-ready.





What You'll Be Doing

Design ultra-realistic neon sign mockups for client review and approval

Produce accurate, production-ready PDF files for neon sign manufacturing

Work from client briefs — take direction clearly and translate it into polished design output

Apply technical knowledge of neon sign manufacturing — tube types, sizing, backing boards, CNC and laser cutting requirements

Use CorelDRAW as the primary tool for all production files

Use Adobe Illustrator for mockup creation, vector work and visual presentation

Manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver consistently to deadlines

Communicate clearly and professionally with the team throughout each project





What We're Looking For

Must Have

CorelDRAW — proficient. Primary tool for all production files. Non-negotiable.

Adobe Illustrator — proficient for realistic mockup creation, vector work and visual presentation

Genuine neon sign design experience — understands the design and manufacturing process end to end

Production-ready file creation — accurate, manufacturer-ready PDF output with correct specs

Ultra-realistic neon sign mockup creation — can present designs compellingly for client approval

Deep technical knowledge of neon sign manufacturing — tube types, materials, sizing and when different specs are used

Understanding of spacing and bleed tolerances between tubes and how these affect production files

Knowledge of tube path layout and how designs are structured for bending and manufacturing

Understanding of CNC and laser cutting requirements — knows how backing boards are cut and how files must be prepared

Production file accuracy — knows what makes a file truly manufacturer-ready, not just visually correct

Detail-oriented — production files must be exact. Errors cost money in manufacturing.

Self-managed and reliable — delivers consistently to deadlines without constant follow-up

Strong English communication — professional and clear throughout

Strong overall graphic design foundation

Bonus Points

Experience working directly with neon sign manufacturers or signage businesses

Experience with LED neon or flexible neon sign production

Experience designing signage for retail, hospitality or events









What to Include in Your Application

1.  Your CV or resume

2.  Portfolio — neon sign mockups and production files you have created

3.  Show us both the client-facing mockup and the production-ready output where possible

4.  A short note on your neon sign design experience and your understanding of the manufacturing process — tube types, sizing, spacing, CNC/laser file prep

5.  Your CorelDRAW proficiency level and version you work in



Applications without a neon sign design portfolio will not be considered. If you don't have genuine neon sign experience — including knowledge of the technical and manufacturing side — do not apply. You will not progress past the first stage of screening.

title: Life Insurance Appointment Setter – Outbound Sales
description:
# Experienced Life Insurance Appointment Setter / Outbound Sales VA (U.S. Market)



**Salary:** $300–$500 USD per month  

**Schedule:** Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours per week  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Working Hours:** U.S. Pacific Time  

**Industry:** Life Insurance / Financial Services



## About the Position



We are a growing U.S.-based life insurance business looking for a highly skilled and motivated appointment setter to join our team.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply reads from a script.



We want a confident, persuasive, and professional communicator who knows how to build rapport, handle objections, and turn conversations into qualified appointments.



You will be contacting leads, identifying their interest in speaking with a licensed life insurance agent, and scheduling appointments.



**Your main goal is to book quality appointments that actually show up—not just fill the calendar.**



## Responsibilities



- Make outbound calls to leads who have provided appropriate permission to be contacted.

- Build genuine rapport and establish trust with potential clients.

- Professionally handle objections such as "I'm not interested," "I'm busy," or "Call me later."

- Qualify prospects using our approved questions.

- Schedule appointments with a licensed life insurance agent.

- Confirm appointments and send approved reminders.

- Update lead information and call outcomes in our CRM.

- Follow up with interested prospects in accordance with our contact policies.

- Maintain accurate daily calling and appointment reports.



## Requirements



- At least 2 years of outbound sales, telemarketing, or appointment-setting experience.

- Previous experience with U.S. life insurance campaigns is strongly preferred.

title: Creative Strategist & Marketing Manager
description:
We’re looking for a creative strategist who’s obsessed with what makes people stop scrolling.



We work with 7–8 figure e-commerce brands and get them amazing results with
 marketing, regularly adding 30–50% to their business, which means hundreds of thousands of dollars in extra monthly revenue.



You’ll own the creative engine behind our growth: ideating and scripting the ads that bring in our clients, and running our podcast so it ships every single week.



You’ll work directly with the founder. He signs off on ideas, then gets out of your way.



We’re looking for someone who wants to learn, develop and take their career to the next level.



If you’re looking for a comfortable, box-checking job, this isn’t it.



If you want to become a top-tier creative strategist and see your ideas go live every week, keep reading.



What you’ll do



Ads creative (your main focus)

- Research our offer, audience and competitors to find angles that make prospects stop scrolling

- Pitch ad concepts to the founder for sign-off

- Write ad scripts and hooks in our brand voice

- Brief the ad editor clearly and manage revisions until the ad is right

- Deliver 30 finished ads a month (7–8 every week), which are also posted as videos on our page



Podcast production

- Own everything from recording onwards, without the founder needing to check it

- Manage the podcast editor and keep the episode on schedule

- Book guests, manage calendars and chase replies

- Handle all distribution across platforms

- Cut and post clips from every episode

- Publish one episode every single week, no missed weeks



Weekly responsibilities

- Pull the best-running ads in our space and write up what’s working and what we should test

- Send the founder a written brief before every Friday call covering ads delivered, podcast status, wins, blockers and next week’s plan

- Write and send a weekly
 to our list (leads, prospects and past contacts)

- Push the team for client case studies and turn the results into ads and sales assets



What success looks like



In your first 30 days

- You’ve learned our offer, audience and brand voice through our training

- You’re pitching ad concepts and writing scripts with early feedback from the founder

- You’ve taken over management of both the ad editor and podcast editor



By 60–90 days

- You own ad creative from concept to finished ad, with the founder only signing off on ideas

- The podcast runs entirely through you from recording onwards

- You hit every KPI consistently without being reminded or chased



Your weekly KPIs

- 7–8 finished ads delivered (30 per month)

- 1 podcast episode published

- 1 competitor swipe and analysis delivered

- Friday brief sent before every call



You’ll be measured on output and results, not hours online. If something is blocking you, we expect you to flag it early and propose a solution, not wait to be asked.



What we’re looking for

- 2+ years ideating and scripting ads or short-form content (DTC/e-commerce preferred)

- A portfolio of ads or short-form videos, with your role in each explained

- Fluent English and sharp, natural writing

- Strong research skills (competitors, Meta Ad Library, audience pain points)

- Experience managing editors or team members and hitting deadlines without being chased

- Strong admin and organization skills (booking guests, managing calendars, following up)

- Able to sustain high output without quality dropping

- Coachable, independent, and fully accountable for results

- Available at least 4 hours a day during UK afternoons

- E-commerce or
 marketing experience is a plus



This role is NOT for you if:



Work style

- You need step-by-step instructions to get things done

- You wait to be told what to do next instead of figuring it out

- You take feedback personally or need multiple rounds of explanation before making changes

- You’d rather stay quiet about a problem than flag it early with a solution



Skills and experience

- You’ve only done editing and never written scripts or pitched concepts yourself

- You’ve never managed an editor, freelancer or team member

- You don’t have a portfolio of ads or short-form content you can show us

- Your English writing needs heavy editing before it can go out



Workload and commitment

- You can’t commit to a weekly output target (7–8 ads plus a podcast episode every week)

- Your quality drops when the volume goes up

- You need someone to chase you for deadlines or updates

- You’re juggling other full-time clients or jobs and can’t give this role your full focus

- You see admin work like booking guests, managing calendars and chasing replies as “beneath” the role

- You’re looking for a short-term gig rather than a long-term role where you grow with us



We have in-depth training on each step of the process, but we’re looking for someone with prior experience in content ideation and scripting, research, managing team members and handling admin tasks.

Ready2Exit is Australia's #1 business marketplace. We help business owners sell the companies they have spent twenty or thirty years building, and we help buyers acquire them properly. Most of the people we deal with are owner operators in trades, manufacturing and services, and for almost all of them, selling their business is the largest financial decision they will ever make.



I am Stuart Earl, Investor, M&A Advisor and leader of Australia's #1 business marketplace, with over 180,000 members.



We are a lean team, so you will work directly with me every day. What you do will show up directly in whether this business grows, and you will be able to watch that happen rather than take my word for it.



What we care about



Most business owners only sell a business once in their life. The industry does not serve them well, and the complaints are always the same: overpromising, no transparency, and no real buyer engagement. We built Ready2Exit to fix that, through preparation, honesty and doing the work properly.



Three things matter here more than anything else, and they will shape your day.



The first is speed. When a business owner calls us back, they are d
 in that moment whether we are serious people. A response forty five minutes later answers that question for them, and not in our favour.



The second is precision. Details carry real weight here. A wrong figure in a follow up email can cost us a mandate that took months to win.



The third is honesty, and that includes honesty upwards. If I have made a mistake, I would rather hear it from you on the day than find it myself a fortnight later. The same applies in the other direction, and I will tell you directly when something is not right. Most people prefer working that way once they get used to it.



The role



You will own the front line of our communication, in both directions.



On one side, we run outreach campaigns and paid advertising that generate inbound calls, replies and form submissions. Those currently sit too long before anyone answers them, and it is the single biggest gap in our week. Closing that gap is the main reason this role exists.



On the other side, when we take on a business to sell, we build a list of buyers who might be a fit and we call them. This is warm work. You are ringing people who are actively looking to buy a business and telling them we have something worth a look.



Either way, you are the first person from Ready2Exit that a buyer or a business owner ever speaks to. You are the first voice of the business, and I treat that as one of the most important seats we have.



What you will be responsible for



The list below is in priority order, and the order genuinely matters. When two things compete, the one higher up wins. You will never need to ask my permission to drop something for an inbound call.



Inbound response. Every call, reply and form submission that comes from our campaigns. Qualify it against criteria I will give you, then book it, route it or close it out. Log every single one. You own that contact from the first touch through to a booked appointment.



Outbound buyer outreach. When we have a business on the market, you will work through a buyer list by phone and email, introduce the opportunity, and book the ones who are interested.



Callbacks and appointment booking. Returning missed calls and managing my diary around them.



Follow up. Post pitch follow up by email and phone, on a cadence that you own and run without me reminding you, plus a weekly sweep of the pipeline for anything that has gone quiet.



Scheduling and rescheduling. Multi party, across time zones, with nothing dropped.



Administration. Onboarding emails and forms, and setting up document folders and permissions for live deals.



A good part of this role runs through our CRM, GoHighLevel. Experience with it is a real plus, though not a dealbreaker. If you are sharp and organised, it is quick to learn, and I will train you on it.



The standard



We are a high performance team and we thrive on overdelivering for our clients.



Fifteen minutes is the response time inside your window. We will measure it, and it will be your key measure of success.



Some mornings a campaign goes out and inbound will take your entire window. Other mornings it will be quiet and you will work through the background list. Both of those are normal and neither is a problem.



Outside your window we are honestly uncovered. Automation acknowledges people and you call them at the start of the next morning. We keep it honest about the size of our team.



Who I am looking for



You have worked somewhere the phone was the revenue. That might be a medical or dental front desk, service dispatch, roadside assistance, insurance claims intake, hotel reservations, client services at a broking firm, or an inbound queue with a target on the wall. What matters is that you have done this under a clock rather than at your own pace.



You will know the specific feeling of being halfway through careful work when something urgent lands. You can deal with the urgent thing, log it properly before you move on, and then go back and finish the careful work without breaking it. Most people manage two of those three. If you can do all three reliably, you are the person I want to talk to.



You will be speaking with Australian business owners, often people who have run their company for decades and do not suffer waffle. You need to be clear, warm and quick on your feet on the phone, able to hold a real conversation and sound like someone worth their time. If you are more comfortable behind email than on a call, this will not suit you. Your written English matters too, because your emails go out under my name into live deals, so they need to read as if I wrote them.



You should get a kick out of a fast moving environment where things change without much warning. Some mornings the plan lasts ten minutes before a campaign lands or a deal moves. If that reads as chaos to you, this will not suit. If it reads as a good morning, we should talk. The people who do well here are comfortable in the unknown and would rather work something out than wait to be told.



Beyond that, I am looking for someone who catches the error nobody flagged, but who also knows when good enough is good enough and the deadline wins. Someone who can be given an outcome rather than a method and work the rest out. Someone who does not need me standing behind them. And someone with mature confidence, by which I mean you will tell me when you think I am wrong, once, with your reasoning, and then get on with the decision either way.



What you get



The rate is $8.75 per hour, with 15 hours guaranteed and up to 20 hours in weeks where the volume requires it, at the same rate.



On growth, I will be straight with you. Our volume is increasing and my intention is to take this role to 30 hours or more within three months. That happens when the workload supports it and when you have shown you can hold the standard. If both of those are true, the hours are there and the path to full time is real.



You will work directly with me, with no layers in between. You will get proper training, and you will learn how business acquisitions actually work, which is exposure that very few people in this market ever get. You will also be trusted with confidential financial information and live deals from early on, because I need this seat close to the real work.



Nice to have, though not required



SharePoint or OneDrive, exposure to Australian clients, or a background in professional services or finance.



How to apply



Please read this section properly. A large number of applications will be set aside for missing a step, and that is deliberate.



Begin your application with the word DISPATCH.

Complete the short application form here: 



It takes about five minutes and it is how I shortlist, so take a little care with it.



That is the whole first step. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short video and a conversation with me after that, so there is nothing to record right now.



I read every completed application and I reply to all of them, including the ones I am not taking forward.



Stuart Earl

Founder, Ready2Exit | Australia's #1 business marketplace

title: Customer Support & Community Manager with Startup Growth Experience – AI Video SaaS
description:
ABOUT US

Clippie AI (clippie.ai) is a fast-growing AI platform that helps creators make faceless short-form videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. We're a small, lean team, and much of our customer community lives on Discord. We're looking for one proactive, reliable person to own customer support and help us grow.



THE ROLE

You will be the first point of contact for our customers and the voice of our Discord community. This is not a "wait for tickets" job. We want someone who notices problems before customers complain, keeps the community active, and brings ideas to help us grow.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Customer Service & Support

- Answer customer questions by Discord quickly and accurately

- Troubleshoot common issues (account, billing, video generation problems) and escalate bugs to the team with clear details

- Handle refund, cancellation and subscription questions professionally

- Build and maintain FAQ and help documentation from recurring questions



Community Building

- Be active in our Discord server every day, answering questions and welcoming new members

- Be active within our Whop community every day, posting updates, polls and answering questions

- Start conversations, run engagement (polls, feature showcases, user spotlights) and keep the server lively

- Moderate the server and keep it spam-free

- Collect user feedback and feature requests and summarise them for the team weekly



Marketing & Growth

- Suggest and help run growth ideas: community campaigns, referral pushes, re-engagement of inactive users

- Help with social media content, script writing and ideation

- Spot upsell and retention opportunities from customer conversations

- Track simple metrics (response times, common issues, community activity) and report weekly

- Help find winning campaigns for us to target



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 1+ years of customer support experience, ideally for a SaaS or tech product

- Hands-on experience managing or moderating a online community

- Experience in marketing or growth for a startup (please give specific examples)

- Excellent written and spoken English with a friendly, clear tone

- Proactive. You take ownership and don't wait to be told what to do

- Comfortable learning new tools quickly

- Reliable internet, a working computer and a quiet workspace



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with AI tools or video and content creation platforms

- Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels

- Experience with tools like Notion, Canva, Miro, Discord



SCHEDULE

Full-time, 40 hours per week. Some overlap with UK/US hours is required. Exact schedule to be agreed.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. A short introduction (no generic templates, please)

2. Examples of communities you've managed or growth results you've achieved

3. One idea for how you'd make an AI video tool's Community more active

4. Start your application with the words "CLIPPIE GROWTH" so we know you read the full listing



Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed.

title: Product Manager - SaaS
description:
gigCMO is a dynamic growth consultancy providing strategic marketing leadership and expertise to start-ups, scale-ups, and SMEs, propelling them toward profitable revenue growth. Nestled in the heart of the City of London, United Kingdom, we specialise in supporting B2B clients in expanding their reach domestically and internationally. Our dedicated team, operating under the banner of Magnacca International, is strategically based in the Philippines. We chose this location for its pool of talent, strong social skills, enthusiasm, and unwavering loyalty.



We are seeking a dedicated and dynamic Product Manager to lead and enhance our Digital Church Platform®. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the product development lifecycle, managing development resources effectively, and ensuring rigorous final testing processes before releasing software updates. You will also play a critical role in translating the strategic vision held by the founder into actionable roadmaps and product deliverables.



Key Responsibilities:



- Manage the Product Development (PD) pipeline, ensuring alignment with organisational goals.

- Prioritise and allocate development resources efficiently to align with strategic priorities.

- Conduct comprehensive final testing and quality assurance to guarantee smooth, error-free software updates before public release.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver product enhancements that meet user needs and drive platform adoption.

- Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders regarding project timelines, milestones, and release schedules.

- Translate strategic vision and high-level ideas from leadership into actionable product roadmaps, user stories, and specifications. 

- Facilitate clear and consistent communication between non-technical stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring all parties are aligned.

- Set up and manage internal systems (e.g. Basecamp and HubSpot) to track backlog, sprints, and milestones.

- Gather feedback from churches and users to shape future features and improvements. 

- Monitor product performance or user feedback loops to inform decisions and prioritisation. 

- Monitor incoming requests via helpdesk and chat channels, triage issues, and ensure timely resolution either directly or by coordinating with the development team.



Qualifications:



- Proven experience in Product Management, ideally within digital platforms or SaaS environments.

- Strong organisational skills with an ability to manage multiple development priorities simultaneously.

- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly in software testing and quality assurance.

- Demonstrable capability in managing software product lifecycles effectively.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to engage stakeholders at various levels.

- Previous experience in digital community platforms or faith-based digital services is advantageous but not essential.

- Experience writing product requirements, specs, and user stories to support development.

- Understanding of user needs in faith-based or nonprofit contexts, particularly around compliance, admin, or community tools, is highly desirable. 

- A mindset geared toward scalability, continuous improvement, and hands-on problem solving in an early-stage SaaS environment.



Application Requirements:



- This role demands a full-time commitment and is not compatible with another full-time job. To be considered, kindly fill out the form using this link: 

- Incomplete submissions will not be considered.



Compensation: Php 30,000 - 40,000 (depending on whether the applicant meets 100% of the requirements)
